a: Aval gabbe temurat velad asham, delekka shem ola al immo, mode rabbi elazar divdamav in hu atzmo la karev.

Etiveh abbaye: vechi bae rabbi elazar shem ola al immo? veha tanya: hammafrish nekeva lefischo — tire ad (sheyyistaev) [shettistaev], vetimmacher, veyavi bedameha pesach. yalda — yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher, veyavi bedamav pesach.

Nishtayyeyra achar happesach, tire ad (sheyyistaev) [shettistaev], veyavi bedameha shelamim. yalda, yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher veyavi bedamav shelamim. rabbi elazar omer: hu atzmo yikrav shelamim.
Veha hacha, delekka shem shelamim al immo, veamar rabbi elazar yikrav shelamim. amar leh (rabbi elazar) [rava]: "achar happesach" ka amrat? shane achar happesach, demotar pesach gufeh karev shelamim.
I hachi, niflog name beresha! amar leh: in hachi name, ufeligi.
Abbaye amar: la pelig midde, digmiri limkom shehammotar holech — havvalad holech; leachar happesach, demotar karev shelamim — valad name karev shelamim.
Aval lifne happesach, immeh lemay akdesha? lidme fesach, valad name lidme fesach.

Metiv rav ukeva bar chama: umi amrinan middeimmeh lidme, valad name lidme? vehatanya: hammafrish nekeva lappesach — hi uvaldoteha yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyimmachru, veyavi bidmehem pesach. rabbi elazar omer: hu atzmo yikrav pesach.
Veha hacha, deimmeh lidme, veamar rabbi elazar: hu atzmo karev pesach, vela mokminan leh beimmeh!

Amar ravina: bemafrish behema meubberet askinan, rabbi elazar savar kerabbi yochanan, deamar: im shiyyeyro meshuyyayr, deubbar lav yerech immo hu, veimmo hi dela kadsha kedushshat hagguf, aval hi kadsha.
Amar leh mar zutera bereh derav mari leravina: hachi name mistabbera devivhema meubberet askinan, middekatane "hi uvaldoteha", shema minna.
b: Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: umode rabbi elazar bemafrish nekeva leasham deen benah karev asham. peshita! ad kan la kaamar rabbi elazar ella bemafrish nekeva leola, deikka shem ola al immo, aval gabbe mafrish nekeva leasham delekka shem asham al immo — afillu rabbi elazar mode delo karev asham!
I lav deashmeinan, hava amena tama derabbi elazar lav mishshum deshem ola al immo, ella mishshum dachaze valad lehakerava, vehay name ha chaze lehakerava, ka mashma lan.
I hachi, addemashma lan deen benah karev asham, nayshmeinan deen benah karev ola, vehu haddin leasham!
I ashmeinan ola, hava amena: ola hu dela karva, dela akdesha leimma (kedushsha ubbarah) [kedushshat ola], aval asham — [kevan deakdesha leimmeh leasham] — ema: valad karev asham, ka mashma lan.
Mishna hammafrish nekeva leasham, tire ad shettistaev, vetimmacher, veyavi bedameha asham. veim karav ashamo, yippelu damav lindava.
Rabbi shimon omer: timmacher shello bemum.
Gemara ulema li tistaev? timmacher! kevan dela chazya lemilleta — hayeynu muma!
Amar rav yehuda, amar rav: hayeynu taam deamrinan, miggo denachata la kedushshat damim — nachata name kedushshat hagguf. amar rava: zot omeret, hikdish zachar ledamav — kadosh kedushshat hagguf.
Ittemar: hikdish zachar ledamav, rav kahana amar: kadosh kedushshat hagguf, rava amar: eno kadosh kedushshat hagguf. vahadar beh rava lidrav kahana, midderav yehuda amar rav.
Rabbi shimon omer: timmacher shello bemum. amar leh rav chiyyay bar avin lerabbi yochanan: miggo denachata leh kedushshat damim, techot leh name kedushshat hagguf!

Amar leh rabbi shimon letameh, deamar: kol midde dela chaze leh legufeh — la nachata leh kedushshat hagguf, detanya: asham ben shana vehevio ben shetayim, ben shetayim vehevio ben shana — keshera, velo alu labbealim leshem chova.
Rabbi shimon omer: kol atzman enan kedoshin.
Vahare mechussar zeman, dela chaze, veamar rabbi shimon dekadosh, shane mechussar zeman, dachaze limchar.
I hachi, asham ben shetayim vehevio ben shana, ha chaze leshana, ella hayeynu tama derabbi shimon bimchussar zeman, deyalef leh mibbechor.

Kidtanya, rabbi shimon ben yehuda amar mishshum rabbi shimon: mechussar zeman nichnas laddir lehitasser, vahare hu kivchor, ma bechor kadosh lifne zemanno vekarev leachar zemanno, af mechussar zeman kadosh lifne zemanno vekarev leachar zemanno.
Tanu rabbanan: hammakdish nekeva leolato

a: Ulefischo velaashamo — osa temura.
Rabbi shimon omer: leolato — osa temura, lefischo velaashamo — en osa temura.
Sheen lecha davar ose temura, ella haroe lehistaev.
Amar rabbi: en ani roe devarav shel rabbi shimon bappesach, hoil umotar happesach karev shelamim.
Velema: en ani roe devarav shel rabbi shimon beasham, hoil umotar asham karev ola! rabbi savar la kerabbanan, deamri: motarot lenidvat tzibbur azli, veen temura betzibbur.
Ka salka datach, hayeynu tama derabbi shimon gabbe mafrish nekeva leolato, mishshum hachi osa temura, dehaikka shem ole aleha gabbe olat haof.
Ella meatta, bechohen gadol shehifrish para lefaro — tikdosh, dehaikka parat chattat! kodshe bedek habbayit hu, vekodshe bedek habbayit la avdi temura.
Yachid shehifrish sair lisirato — tikdosh, dehaikka seir nasi! i name, nasi shehifrish seira lisiro — tikdosh, deha yachid mafrish seira!
Hane tere gufe ninhu.
Chatu ad shello nitmannu, ki mafresh sair lisirato — tikdosh, deha illu chata hasheta — bar etoye sair hu! ha la chata — la ichayyayv besair.
I hachi, hacha name, ha lav olat haof kamayyte!
Rabbi shimon savar la kerabbi elazar ben azarya, ditnan: "hare alay ola" — yavi keves. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: o tor o bene yona.
Tenan hatam: hammakdish nechasav, vehaya bahen behema reuya legabbe mizbeach, zecharim unekevot.
Rabbi eliezer omer: zecharim yimmachru letzorche olot, unekevot yimmachru letzorche shelamim, udemehen yippelu im shear nechasim levedek habbayit.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: zecharim atzman yikrevu olot, unekevot yimmachru letzorche shelamim, veyavi bidmehen olot, ushear nechasim yippelu levedek habbayit.
Amar leh rabbi chiyyay bar abba lerabbi yochanan: lerabbi yehoshua deamar zecharim atzman yikrevu olot, unekevot hechi (mikkarban) [karvan] shelamim? ha mikkoach kedushsha dechuyyay kaatyayn!

Lishshana achrina, amar leh rabbi chiyyay bar abba lerabbi yochanan: middekaamar rabbi yehoshua zecharim atzman yikrevu olot, lememra dikdushshat hagguf akdeshinhu? i hachi, nekevot ammay yimmachru letzorche shelamim? baaya reiyyay!

Amar leh rabbi yehoshua savar la kerabbi shimon, deamar: kol midde dela chaze leh legufeh — la nachata leh kedushshat hagguf. ditnan, rabbi shimon omer: timmacher shello bemum, veamrinan detama derabbi shimon — kevan dela chazya nekeva leasham, la nachata leh kedushshat hagguf.
Emor deamar rabbi shimon gabbe nekeva leasham,
b: Delekka shem asham al immo, aval gabbe nekeva leola deikka shem ola al immo — afillu rabbi shimon mode!
Veod, ha shaminan leh lerabbi shimon: leolato ose temura!
Amar leh rabbi yehoshua savar leh keiddach tanna allibba derabbi shimon, detanya: rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: af leolato en ose temura.

Mishna temurat asham, velad temura, veladan velad veladan ad sof kol haolam — yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyimmachru, veyippelu (damav) [demehen] lindava. rabbi eliezer omer: yamutu. verabbi elazar omer: yavi bidmeh olot.
Asham shemmetu bealav, veshekkipperu bealav — yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyimmachru, veyippelu damav lindava. rabbi eliezer omer: yamutu. rabbi elazar omer: yavi bedameha ola.
Vahalo af nedava ola hi, uma ben divre rabbi elazar ledivre chachamim? ella, bizman shehi baa ola — somech aleha, umevi nesachim, unesacheha mishshello. im haya kohen — avodatah veorah shello.
Uvizman shehi nedava — eno somech aleha, veeno mevi aleha nesachim, unesacheha mishshel tzibbur, af al pi shehu kohen — avodatah veorah mishshel anshe mishmar.
Gemara utzericha:
Dei ashmeinan asham, beha kaamar rabbi eliezer yamutu, mishshum degazar leachar kappara attu lifne kappara.
Aval gabbe temurat asham, velad temuratah, ema mode lehu lerabbanan.
Vei ashmeinan hatam, beha kaamri rabbanan, aval gabbe asham modu leh lerabbi eliezer — tzericha.
Amar rav nachman, amar rabba bar avu: machloket leachar kappara, aval lifne kappara — divre hakkol hu atzmo yikrav asham.
Amar rava: shete teshuvot baddavar, chada deen adam mitkapper bedavar habba baavera, veod, hatane rav chananya lesayyoe lerabbi yehoshua ben levi deamar valad rishon karev, velad sheni eno karev!
Ella, i ittemar, hachi ittemar: amar rav nachman, amar rabba bar avu: machloket kodem kappara, aval leachar kappara — hu atzmo karev ola.
Vehatane rav chananya lesayyoe lerabbi yehoshua ben levi! kashya.

Bea minneh rabbi avin bar chiyyay merabbi avin bar kahana: hifrish nekeva leasham, benah mahu sheyyikrav leola? vetifshot leh midderabbi yose berabbi chanina, deamar: mode rabbi elazar. la shemia leh.
May amar leh: benah karev ola. hay may? ad kan la kaamar rabbi elazar ella mafrish nekeva leola, deikka shem ola al immo, aval gabbe asham delekka shem ola al immo — afillu rabbi eliezer mode!
Amar leh: tama derabbi elazar, lav mishshum deshem ole al immo, ella mishshum dachaze lehakerava, veha name chaze lehakerava.
Etiveh: veladan velad veladan ad sof kol haolam yavi bidmehen ola — bidmehen — in,

a: Atzmo — lo! hacha vemay askinan? kegon sheyyalda nekeva, vead sof haolam lo olid chad zachar?! amar leh: meshannena [lach] shinnuye dechiki bavlae, kegon sheyyalda nekevot ad sof haolam.
Mishna temurat habbechor vehammaaser, veladan velad veladan ad sof haolam — hare ellu kivchor uchemaaser, veyeachlu bemuman labbealim.
Ma ben bechor umaaser leven kol hakkodashim? shekkol hakkodashim nimkarim baitlez, venishchatin baitlez, venishkalin belitra, chutz min habbechor vehammaaser.

Veyesh lahen pidyon, velitmurotehen pidyon, chutz min habbechor vehammaaser. uvain mechutza laaretz, chutz min habbechor vehammaaser, sheim bau temimim — yikrevu, veim baale mumin — yeachlu bemuman labbealim.
Amar rabbi shimon: ma taam shehabbechor vehammaaser yesh lahen parnasa mimmekoman, ushear kol hakkodashim, af al pi shennolad bahem mum — hare ellu bikdushshatan.
Gemara amar rava bar rav azza: baan bemareva — hammetil mum bitmurat bechor umaaser mahu? mi amrinan: kevan dela kerivan — la michayyayv, o dilma: kevan dekadshu — michayyayv?
Amar leh abbaye: vetibbee lach hammetil mum bitshii shel maaser!
Ella may shena teshii, dela kamibbaya lach? derachamana maateh, "asiri" — lehotzi hatteshii.
Hachi name, rachamana maatinhu, "lo tifde kodesh hem" — hem kerevin, veen temuratan kereva.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak matne la hachi: amar rav acha bereh derav azza, baan bemareva: hammetil mum bitshii shel maaser mahu? amar leh: vetibbee lach hammetil mum bitmurat bechor umaaser!

Ella may shena temurat bechor umaaser dela mibbaya lach? derachamana maatinhu, "kodesh hem" — hen kerevin veen temuratan kereva. teshii shel maaser name rachamana maateh, "haasiri" — lehotzi et hatteshii.
Veim bau temimin kulei. ureminhu: ben antignos heela bechorot mibbavel velo kibbelu mimmennu! amar rav chisda: la kashya, ha — rabbi yishmael, ha — rabbi akiva.
Detanya: rabbi yose omer shelosha devarim mishshum shelosha zekenim, rabbi yishmael omer: yachol yaale adam maaser sheni bizman hazze veyochlennu birushalayim?

Vedin hu: bechor taun havaat makom, umaaser taun havaat makom. ma bechor eno neechol ella bifne habbayit, af maaser eno neechol ella bifne habbayit. lo, im amarta bivchor — shekken taun mattan damim veemurim legabbe mizbeach, tomar bemaaser dela?!
Amarta: bikkurim teunin havaat makom, umaaser taun havaat makom. ma bikkurim en neechalin ella bifne habbayit, af maaser en neechol ella bifne habbayit.
Ma levikkurim, shekken teunin hannacha, tomar bemaaser dela?!

Talmud lomar: "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha... masar degancha vetiroshcha veyitzharecha uvechorot bekarcha vetzonecha", hikkish maaser livchor: ma bechor eno neechol ella bifne habbayit, af maaser en neechol ella bifne habbayit.
Velehdar dina, velete bema hatztzad"!
Amar rav ashe: mishshum deikka lememar, ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken yesh bahen tzad mizbeach.

Umay kasavar? i kasavar kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah vekiddesha leatid lavo, la shena bechor vela shena maaser bene havaa ninhu. vei kasavar kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah velo kiddesha leatid lavo, afillu bechor name tibbee lach!
Leolam kasavar, kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah velo kiddesha leatid lavo, vehacha bemay askinan — kegon shennizrak damo shel bechor bifne habbayit, vecharav habbayit, vaadayin besaro kayyaym.
Kevan dei iteh ledam (lo) [lav] bar zerika hu, ate basar yalef middam,
b: Veate maaser veyalef mibbechor. umi yalfinan (kodesh) [bekadashim] mehadade? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: kol hattora kullah lemedin lamed min hallamed, chutz min hakkodashim sheen lemedin lamed min hallamed!
Maaser chullin hu. hanicha leman deamar batar lamed azlinan, ella leman deamar batar melammed azlinan, may ikka lememar? basar vadam chada milleta hi.

Rabbi akiva omer: yachol yaale adam bechor mechutza laaretz laaretz bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym veyakrivennu? talmud lomar: "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha masar degancha vetiroshcha veyitzharecha uvechorot bekarcha vetzonecha" — mimmekom sheatta maale masar dagan, atta maale bechor.
Umimmekom shei atta maale masar dagan — i atta maale bechor.

Ben azzay omer: yachol (maale et) [yaale adam] maaser sheni, veyochlennu bechol haroe? vedin hu: bechor taun havaat makom, umaaser taun havaat makom — ma bechor eno neechol ella lifnim min hachoma, af maaser eno neechol ella lifnim min hachoma.

Ma livchor — shekken taun mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach, tomar bemaaser dela?! talmud lomar: "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha... masar degancha vetiroshcha veyitzharecha uvechorot bekarcha vetzonecha" — makkish maaser livchor: ma bechor eno neechol ella lifnim min hachoma, af maaser eno neechol ella lifnim min hachoma.
May kashya leh dekaamar "yachol"? amarta hoil utenan: en ben shilo lirushalayim ella shebbeshilo ochlin kadashim kallim umaaser sheni bechol haroe, uvirushalayim lifnim min hachoma,
Vechen kodshe kadashim lifnim min hakkelaim, mahu detema birushalayim layte maaser sheni bechol haroe? ka mashma lan.
Acherim omrim: yachol yehe bechor sheibbera shenato kifsule hammukedashin, veyippasel?
Talmud lomar: "masar degancha vetiroshcha veyitzharecha", makkish bechor lemaaser, ma maaser eno nifsal mishshana lachavertah, af bechor eno nifsal mishshana lachavertah.
Ulerabbanan, demappeki lehu letama acharina, mishshana lachavertah mena lehu? nafka lehu millifne Adonai elohecha tochlennu shana veshana", limmed al habbechor sheeno nifsal mishshana lachavertah.

Velaacherim, lifne "Adonai elohecha tochlennu shana veshana", may darshi beh? mibbee leh lechidtanya: yom echad mishshana zo, veyom echad mishshana acheret, limmed al habbechor shenneechol lishne yamim valayla echad.
Verabbanan, deneechol lishne yamim valayla echad mena lehu? amar kera: "yihye lach kachaze hattenufa".
Hadaran alach ellu kadashim.
Mishna velad chattat, utemurat chattat, vechattat shemmetu bealeha — yamutu, vesheibbera shenatah, vesheavda venimtzet baalat mum, im mishshekkipperu habbealim — tamut, veenah osa temura.

a: Lo nehenin velo moalin, veim ad shello kipperu habbealim — tire ad shettistaev, vetimmacher veyavi bedameha acheret, veosa temura umoalin bah.
Gemara may tama la tane lehu gabbe hadade? resha — pesika leh, vesefa — la pesika leh.
Lema li lemitneyay gabbe meila, lema li lemitneyay gabbe temura? tena hacha temura, veayyeyde ditna temura — tena name meila, veayyeyde ditna gabbe meila meila — tena name temura.
Amar resh lakish: chattat sheibbera shenatah, roin otah keillu omedet bevet hakkevarot, veroa.
Tenan: sheibbera shenatah, veavda venimtzet baalat mum, im achar shekkipperu bealim — meta, teyuveta deresh lakish!
Amar lach resh lakish: ki katane resha "meta" — aavda venimtzet baalat mum, im achar shekkipperu bealim — tamut.
I hachi, ema sefa: "im ad shello kipperu habbealim tire ad shettistaev", vei baalat mum — ha mesaava vekayyma!
Amar rabba: hachi kaamar tanna: sheavda venimtzet baalat mum over, im achar shekkipperu bealim — meta, im kodem shekkipperu bealim — tire ad shettistaev bemum kavua, vetimmacher.
Amar rava: shete teshuvot baddavar, chada — deim ken, "yishmor" mibbee leh lemitne, veod — "sheibbera shenatah" lemay hilcheta katane?
Ella amar rava: hachi katane, ibbera shenatah veavda, o avda venimtzet baalat mum — achar shekkipperu habbealim meta, kodem shekkipperu habbealim tire ad shettistaev vetimmacher.

Vetzarich lemitne "im avda" gabbe baalat mum, vegabbe ibbera shenatah, dei tena gabbe sheibbera shenatah — hava amena hatam hu demahneya la aveda, mishshum dela chazya lemilleta, aval baalat mum dei la muma chazya — ema la tahane leh aveda.
Vei tane gabbe baalat mum, hatam hu demahneya la aveda, mishshum dela chazya lehakerava, aval ibbera shenatah dechazya lehakerava, ema la tahane la aveda, tzericha.
Umi amar rava hachi? vehaamar rava: aveda delayla la shema aveda!
La dame aveda delelya — la chazya la legufa vela lidme, aval ha — nehi dilgufa la chazya, lidme chazya.
Tenan: hashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher, veyippelu damav lindava, lefi sheen chattat hatztzibbur meta. ha deyachid — meta!
Veamar rabbi yochanan: baale chayyim nidchin, ucheshehu mitkapper — besheni shebbezug sheni mitkapper.
Veiddach, kamma, have leh ki ibbera shenatah, vetama detzibbur, ha deyachid — meta!
Amar lach: dechuyin lechud, vaavudin lechud. may tama? avudin — dateh alehon, dilma mishtachchin. dechuyin — la hadari mitchazayin.
b: Gufa: amar rava: avuda delayla la shema avuda. allibba deman? ilema allibba derabbanan — may irya avuda delayla? afillu avuda deyom name, deamri rabbanan: avuda bishat haferasha roa.
Veella, allibba derabbi, ad kan la kaamar rabbi ella aveda deyom, aval aveda delayla — afillu rabbi mode deliriyyay azla.

Ibbaet ema: leolam allibba derabbanan, vehacha vemay askinan — beavda bishat kappara. ad kan la kaamri rabbanan avda bishat kappara meta, ella hecha deikkar avedatah bayyom, aval hecha deikkar avedatah ballayla — la.
Amar abbaye: naktinan, aveda velo genuva, aveda velo gezula.
Hechi dame aveda? amar rabbi oshaya: afillu achat beedro, vaafillu achat beachat. verabbi yochanan amar: achore haddelet.

Ibbaya lehu: hechi kaamar? achore haddelet hu delekka deka chaze la, aval abbaray deikka dachaze la — la havya avuda, o dilma achore haddelet dei mahdar appeh chaze la — havya avuda, vechol shekken abbaray dela kachaze la? teku.
Amar rav pappa: gamrinan avuda mimmennu velo meroah — la havya avuda, vechol shekken avuda meroah velo avuda mimmennu. avuda mimmennu umeroah, veechad besof haolam makkir bah — may? teku.
Bae rav pappa: avuda bakkos mahu? allibba deman? ilema allibba derabbi — haamar avuda bishat haferasha meta!
Ella, ki kamibbaya leh allibba derabbanan, mi amrinan: ki amri rabbanan bishat haferasha roa, kodem sheyyekabbel damah bakkos, aval hacha sevira lehu: kol haomed lizzarek kezaruk dame.
O dilma, kema dela izderik dam — ki avda bishat haferasha damya, veraaya.
Veikka deamri: leolam allibba derabbi, ki kamibbaya leh — kegon shekkibbel damah bishte chosot, veavad echad mehen.
Veallibba deman deamar kos ose chavero dachuy — la tibbee lach, ki tibbee lach allibba deman deamar kos ose chavero shirayim.
Hane mille — hecha deitanhu letarvayyhu, dechol hecha devae zarek; aval hacha — ha lekka, o dilma la shena? teku.
Mishna hammafrish chattat, veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha, veachar kach nimtzet harishona — tamut.
Hammafrish maot lechattato, veavdu, vehifrish chattat tachtehem, veachar kach nimtzeu hammaot — yolichem leyam hammelach.
Hammafrish maot lechattat, veavdu, vehifrish maot acherot tachtehen, velo hispik likkach chattat mehen ad shennimtzeu harishonot — yavi meellu umeellu chattat, vehashshear yippelu lindava.

Hammafrish maot lechattato veavdu, vehifrish chattat tachtehen, lo hispik lehakerivah ad shennimtzeu hammaot, vahare chattat baal mum — timmacher, veyavi meellu umeellu chattat, vehashshear yippelu lindava.

Hammafrish chattat veavda, vehifrish maot tachteha, velo hispik likkach mehen chattat ad shennimtza chattato, vahare hi baalat mum — timmacher, veyavi meellu umeellu chattat, vehashshear yippelu lindava.

Hammafrish chattato veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha, lo hispik lehakerivah ad shennimtzet harishona, vahare shetehen baalat mum — yimmachru, veyavi meellu umeellu chattat, vehashshear yippelu lindava.

Hammafrish chattat, veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha, lo hispik lehakerivah ad shennimtzet harishona, hayu shetehen temimot — achat mehen tikrav chattat, vehashsheniyya tamut, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: en chattat meta ella shennimtzet meachar shekkipperu habbealim, veen hammaot holchim leyam hammelach ella shennimtzeu meachar shekkipperu habbealim.
Hammafrish chattat, vahare hi baalat mum — mochrah, veyavi bedameha acheret. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: im karva sheniyya ad shello nishchata — tamut, shekkevar kipperu habbealim.
Gemara tama dehikriv acheret tachteha, ha lo hikriv acheret tachteha — roa. manni? rabbanan hi, deamri: avuda bishat haferasha — roa.

Ema sefa: hammafrish maot lechattat veavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehem — yavi meellu umeellu, vehashshear yippelu lindava. tama meellu umeellu, ha hevi meechad mehen — hashsheni yolicho leyam hammelach. atan lerabbi, deamar: avuda bishat haferasha meta.
Resha rabbanan, vesefa rabbi?! hanicha lerav huna, deamar rav huna amar rav:

a: Hakkol modim sheim mashach achat vehikrivah shehashsheniyya meta, mashkachat lah kegon shemmashach achat mehen vehikriv, vedivre hakkol.

Ella lerabbi abba amar rav, deamar: hakkol modim bemitkapper besheenah avuda — sheavuda meta. al ma nechleku? bemitkapper baavuda, derabbi savar: mafrish leibbud keibbud dame, verabbanan savri: lav keibbud dame.
Resha setam lan kerabbanan, sefa setam lan kerabbi.

Umay kamashma lan, difligi rabbi verabbanan? behedya katane la machloket rabbi verabbanan besefa: hammafrish chattat veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha, veachar kach nimtzet harishona, vahare shetehen omdot — achat mehen tikrav, usheniyya tamut, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: en chattat meta ella shennimtzet meachar shekkipperu bealim, veen maot holchot leyam hammelach ella shennimtzeu meachar shekkipperu bealim!
Ha kamashma lan, davar ze machloket rabbi verabbanan.

Gufa, amar rav huna, amar rav: hakkol modim sheim mashach achat vehikrivah — shehashsheniyya meta. lo nechleku ella beva limmalech, derabbi savar: lo asu takkana bekadashim, veamrinan lach hitkapper besheenah avuda, vaavuda meta. verabbanan savri: asu takkana bakkodashim, veamrinan lach hitkapper baavuda, vesheenah avuda tire.
Motev rav mesharsheya: velo asu takkana bakkodashim? vehatanya: "yochlu", ma talmud lomar? melammed sheim hayta achila muetet, ochlin immah chullin uteruma, kede shettehe neechelet al hassava.
"Yochluha", ma talmud lomar? sheim hayta achila merubba, en ochlin immah chullin uteruma, kede shello tehe neechelet al haggassa.
May lav afillu rabbi? la, rabbanan.
Verabbi abba amar rav: hakkol modim bemitkapper besheenah avuda, sheavuda meta. al ma nechleku? demitkapper baavuda, derabbi savar: mafrish leibbud keibbud dame, verabbanan savri: lav keibbud dame.
Tenan: hashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher, veyippelu damav lindava, sheen chattat tzibbur meta. ha deyachid — meta.
Veamar rav: baale chayyim enan nidchin, keshehu mitkapper besheni shebbezug rishon mitkapper, veiddach batra hava leh kemafrish leibbud, vetama detzibbur, ha deyachid meta.
b: May lav afillu rabbanan? la, rabbi hi.
Tenan: hammafrish chattat veavda, vehikriv acheret tachteha — tamut.
Tama (dikreva) [mishshum dehikrivah], ha lo hikrivah — tire, la shena mitkapper baavuda, la shena mitkapper besheenah avuda, la shena mashach, vela shena lo mashach.
Teyuveta detarvayyhu!
Milleta difsika leh — katane, milleta dela pesika leh — la katane.
Tenan: hammafrish maot lechattat, veavdu, vehifrish acherim tachtehem, veachar kach nimtzeu hammaot — yavi meellu umeellu chattat, vehashshear yippelu lindava.
Tama demitkapper meellu umeellu, ha meechad — yolichem leyam hammelach.

La shena mitkapper baavuda, vela shena mitkapper besheenah avuda, vela shena mashach, vela shena lo mashach — teyuveta detarvayyhu! hacha name: milleta difsika leh katane, umilleta dela pesika leh la katane.
Amar rabbi amme: hammafrish shene tzibbure maot leachrayut, mitkapper beechad mehen, vesheni yippelu lindava.
Allibba deman? ilema allibba derabbi — peshita deyippelu lindava, ad kan la kaamar rabbi ella bemafrish leibbud, aval leachrayut mode.
Veella allibba derabbanan, peshita leh deyippelu lindava, kal vachomer: hasheta mafrish leibbud amur rabbanan lav keibbud dame, leachrayut mibbaya?!
Veella, allibba derabbi shimon itztericha leh, mahu detema let leh lerabbi shimon nedava, ka mashma lan deit leh nedava.

Umi matzet amrat delet leh nedava lerabbi shimon? vehatanya: shelosha asar shofarot hayu bammikdash, vehaya katuv alehen: "tiklin chadtin" veattikin", "kinnin" vegozle ola", "etzim" ulevona" vezahav lechapporet", veshishsha lindava.
Vetane ala: shishsha lindava — leola habbaa min hammotarot, sheen orah lakkohanim, divre rabbi yehuda.

Amar lo rabbi nechemya, veamri la rabbi shimon: im ken, batla midrasho shel yehoyada hakkohen. detanya: ze midderash darash yehoyada hakkohen — "asham hu" kullo, lehavi kol davar habba mimmotar chattaot vaashamot, likkach bedamav olot — habbasar lashshem, veorot lakkohanim.
Alma it leh nedava lerabbi shimon, itzterich, salka datach amena: ki it leh nedava lerabbi shimon bechad sidra,

a: Aval bitre sidre la, ka mashma lan.
Amar rabbi hoshaya: hammafrish shete chattaot leachrayut, mitkapper beachat mehen, vachavertah roa.
Allibba deman? ilema allibba derabbanan — hasheta hammafrish leibbud, amri rabbanan lav keibbud dame, leachrayut mibbaya?!
Ella allibba derabbi shimon, haamar rabbi shimon: chamesh chattaot metot!
Ella, allibba derabbi, ki amar rabbi beibbud — aval achrayut la.
Tenan: hammafrish chattat, vahare hi baalat mum — mochrah, umevi acheret tachteha. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: im karva sheniyya kodem shennishchata rishona — tamut, shekkevar kipperu bealeha.
Ka salka datach derabbi elazar berabbi shimon kerabbi sevira leh, vaafillu beachrayut name!
La, dilma rabbi elazar berabbi shimon kaavu sevira leh, deamar: chamesh chattaot metot.
Tenan: lefi sheen chattat tzibbur meta, ha deyachid meta.
Amar rav: baale chayyin enan nidchin, keshehu mitkapper besheni shebbezug rishon mitkapper, veiddach have leh achrayut, vekatane deyachid meta!
Rav letameh, deamar: mitzva barishon.
Tane rav shimi bar zeri kammeh derav pappa: avda bishat haferasha — lerabbi meta, lerabbanan tire. avda bishat kappara — lerabbanan meta, lerabbi roe.
Kal vachomer: uma avuda bishat haferasha, deamri rabbanan roa, amar rabbi meta — avuda bishat kappara, dilrabbanan meta, lerabbi lo kol shekken?
Ella tane hachi: avuda bishat haferasha — lerabbi meta, lerabbanan roa. bishat kappara — divre hakkol meta.
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer vechulei.
Tanu rabbanan: en margilin beyom tov, keyotze vo — en margilin bivchor, velo bifsule hammukedashin.
Bishlama beyom tov — deka tarach tircha dela chaze leh, ella bechor — man tena?
Amar rav chisda: bet shammay hi, deamar: bechor bikdushsheteh kae, ditnan: bet shammay omrim: lo yimmane yisrael im hakkohen al habbechor.
Pesule hammukedashin, man tanna? amar rav chisda: rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi, detanya: hayu lefanav shete chattaot, achat temima veachat baalat mum — temima tikrav, baalat mum tippade.
Nishchata baalat mum, ad shello nizrak damah shel temima — mutteret; mishshennizrak damah shel temima — asura.
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: afillu besar baalat mum bakkedera, venizrak damah shel temima — yotze levet haserefa.
Verav chisda, lokma idde veidde kevet shammay!
Dilma ki amri bet shammay — bivchor, dikdushsheteh merechem, aval pesule hammukedashin — la.
Velokma idde veidde kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon!
Dilma ki amar rabbi elazar berabbi shimon — bifsule mukedashin, deallimi lemitpas pidyonan, aval bivchor — la.
Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon, let leh ha ditnan: kol pesule hammukedashin nishchatin baitliz venimkarin baitliz venishkalin belitra? alma, kevan desharet leh tafe vezaven!
Amar rav mari bereh derav kahana: ma shemmashbiach baor — pogem bevasar.
Amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi avin: mippene shennire keoved avoda bekadashim.
Rabbi yose bar avin amar: gezera shemma yegaddel mehem adarim adarim.
Hadaran alach velad chattat.
b: Mishna ketzad maarimin al habbechor? mevakkeret shehayta meubberet, omer: "ma shebbemeeha shel zo im zachar — ola", yalda zachar — yikrav ola, "veim nekeva — zivche shelamim", yalda nekeva — tikrav shelamim.

"Im zachar — ola, veim nekeva — zivche shelamim", yalda zachar unekeva — hazzachar yikrav ola, vehannekeva tikrav shelamim. yalda shene zecharim — echad mehem yikrav ola, vehashsheni yimmacher lechayyayve ola, vedamav chullin.

Yalda shete nekevot — achat mehem tikrav shelamim, vehashsheniyya timmacher lechayyayve shelamim, vedameha chullin. yalda tumetum veanderoginos — rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: en kedushsha chala alehen.
Gemara amar rav yehuda: muttar lehattil mum bivchor kodem sheyyetze laavir haolam. tenan: omer adam "ma shebbemeeha shel zo ola" — ola in, shelamim la, veat amrat dematzet mafkeat leh mikkedushsheta!
Amar lach rav yehuda: hane mille — bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, ki kaamena ana — bizman hazze, dela chaze lehakerava.
I bizman hazze, may lememra? mahu detema: nigzar, dilma nafek rov rosho vekashade beh muma.
Veema: hachi name! afillu hachi — ha adifa yattira, middeate beh lide gizza vaavoda.
Im nekeva zivche shelamim — nekeva mi ka kadsha bivchora? sefa atya livhema dehekdesh.
Yalda shene zecharim kulei. amri: i behema dehekdesh, hayech deakdesh ola — lehdar ola, iddach neheve bikdushshetay deimmeh! sefa atan levehemat chullin.
Yalda tumetum veanderoginos kulei.

a: Ammay en kedushsha chala alehen? kasavar rabban shimon ben gamliel: valdot kadashim bahavayaytan hen kedoshin, dei salka datach mimmee imman hen kedoshin — ammay en kedushsha chala alehen? ha tefastinhu kedushsha deimmayyhu! ella shema minna: valde kadashim bahavayaytan hen kedoshim.

Vehay tanna savar valde kadashim mimmee imman hen kedoshim, detanu rabbanan: illu lo neemar "bechor lo yakdish" hayiti omer bechor lo yakdish hekdeshot, talmud lomar "ish oto" — oto i atta makdish, aval makdish adam bechor hekdeshot.
Vaadayin ani omer: hu lo yakdish, aval yakdishuhu acherim. talmud lomar "bivhema" — bivhema asakti.
Yachol lo yakdishennu babbeten? talmud lomar "asher yevukkar laAdonai" — mishsheyyevukkar laAdonai i atta makdish, aval atta makdish babbeten.
Yachol af valde kol hakkodashim ken, talmud lomar "ach" — chalak, alma sevira leh valde kadashim mimmee imman hen kedoshin.
Amar leh rav amram lerav sheshet: amar al habbechor "im yetziat rubbo — ola", ola have o bechor have?
Ola have, dechol pureta ufureta deka nafek have kalil, o bechor have, dechol pureta ufureta deka nafek bemilleteh hu?
Lishshana achrina: shekken kedushsha chayyla aleh, o dilma bechor have — shekken kedushshato merechem.
Amar leh: may tibbee lach? hayeynu devae ilfa: amar al halleket "im neshirat rubbo — yehe hefker", leket have o hefker have?
Leket have, shekken kedushshato bide shamayim, o dilma hefker have, shekken zochin bo aniyyim vaashirim?
Veamar abbaye: may tibbee leh? divre harav vedivre talmid — divre mi shomim? hachi name: divre mi shomim?
Mishna haomer "veladah shel zo ola, vehi shelamim" — devarav kayyaymim. "hi shelamim, uveladah ola" — hare ze velad zivche shelamim, divre rabbi meir.

Amar rabbi yose: im lechen nitkavven techilla, hoil vei efshar likrot shene shemot keachat — devarav kayyaymin, veim mishsheamar "hare zo shelamim" nimlach veamar "veladah ola" — hare zo veladah shelamim.
Gemara amar rabbi yochanan: hifrish chattat meubberet veyalda — ratza bah mitkapper, ratza bivladah mitkapper.
May tama? kasavar rabbi yochanan: im shiyyeyro — meshuyyayr.
Ubbar lav yerech immo hu, dehave leh kemafrish shete chattaot leachrayut — ratza mitkapper bah, ratza mitkapper bachavertah.
Motev rabbi elazar: "hi shelamim uveladah ola" — hare ze velad shelamim, vei salka datach shiyyeyro meshuyyayr, "hare ze velad shelamim" — "hare zo shelamim" bae mitna!
Amar rav tavla: bar minna dehahi, ha amar rav letanna: teni "hare zo shelamim".
Metivi: haomer leshifchato "hare et shifcha, uveladech ben chorin", im hayta ubbara — zachta lo.
I amrat bishlama im shiyyeyro eno meshuyyayr, ubbar yerech immo, mishshum hachi zachta lo, vehave leh kimshachrer chatzi avdo. umanni? rabbi meir hi, kidtanya:
b: Hameshachrer chatzi avdo yatza lecherut, gitto veyado bain keechat.

Vei amrat: shiyyeyro meshuyyayr, ubbar lav yerech immo hu, ammay zachta lo? veha tanya: nirin shehaeved zoche lekabbel get shichrur shel chavero miyyad rabbo sheeno shello, velo miyyad rabbo shello. ella shema minna: im shiyyeyro eno meshuyyayr, uteyuveta derabbi yochanan teyuveta.

Lema im shiyyeyro meshuyyayr tannae hi? detanya: haomer leshifchato "hare at bat chorin uveladech eved" — veladah kamoha, divre rabbi yose haggelili. vachachamim omrim: devarav kayyaymin, mishshum shenneemar "haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha".
Kera may talmuda lerabbanan? amar rava: amar kera lerabbi yose haggelili, dekatane veladah kamoha, shenneemar: "haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha" — bizman shehaishsha laadoneha, veladah laadoneha.
May lav beha kamippalgi, derabbi yose savar: shiyyeyro — eno meshuyyayr, verabbanan savri: meshuyyayr?
Amar lach rabbi yochanan: dechulle alma shiyyeyro — meshuyyayr, vehacha hayeynu tama deamar kera "haishsha viladeha tihye laadoneha".

Ella vadday lema ki hane tannae, detanya: hashshochet et hachattat umatza bah ben arbaa chay, tane chada: en neechelet ella lezichre chehunna, veenah neechelet ella leyom echad, veenah neechelet ella lifnim min hakkelaim.
Vetanya iddach: neechelet lechol adam, veneechelet bechol makom, veneechelet leolam.
May lav tannae, detanna kamma savar: "shiyyeyro" — eno meshuyyayr, umar savar: "shiyyeyro" — meshuyyayr.

Amar lach rabbi yochanan: dechulle alma im shiyyeyro — meshuyyayr, vehane tannae beha kamippalgi, demar savar: valde kadashim bahavayaytan hen kedoshim, umar savar: valde kadashim bime imman hen kedoshim.
Veibbaet ema: la kashya, kan — beshehikdishah ulevassof nitabbera,
Kan — beshennitabbera ulevassof hikdishah.
Matkef la rava: mimmay detama derabbi yochanan im shiyyeyro meshuyyayr? dilma hayeynu tama derabbi yochanan deadam mitkapper beshevach hekdesh.

Amar leh rav hamenuna: rabbi elazar talmideh derabbi yochanan, veyatev lekammeh derabbi yochanan, vela ahdar leh hay shinnuya, veat amrat tama derabbi yochanan mishshum deadam mitkapper beshevach hekdesh?!
Im mishsheamar "hare zo shelamim" nimlach kulei. peshita veladan shelamim, ella kol emat devae mimmelech?
Amar rav pappa: lo nitzrecha ella sheamar betoch kede dibbur, mahu detema toch kede dibbur kedibbur, vehay ayyyone hu dekamayyen — ka mashma lan.
Mishna "hare zo temurat ola temurat shelamim" — hare zo temurat ola, divre rabbi meir.
Amar rabbi yose: im lechen nitkavven techilla, hoil vei efshar likrot shene shemot keachat — devarav kayyaymim, veim mishsheamar "temurat ola" nimlach veamar "temurat shelamim" — hare zo temurat ola.

a: Gemara amar rabbi yitzchak berabbi yose amar rabbi yochanan: hakkol modim beomer "tachul zo" veachar kach "tachul zo" — divre hakkol tefos lashon rishon.
"Lo tachul zo ella im ken chalta zo" — tarvavyyhu kadshi.

Lo nechleku ella kegon mishnatenu, deamar "temurat ola temurat shelamim", derabbi meir savar: middahava leh lememar "temurat ola ushelamim", veamar "temurat ola temurat shelamim" — havya leh keomer "tachul zo veachar kach tachul zo".
Verabbi yose savar, i amar "temurat ola ushelamim", hava amena kedosha veenah kereva, ka mashma lan.

Tanu rabbanan: haomer "behema zo chetzyah temurat ola vechetzyah temurat shelamim" — kullah tikrav ola, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: tire ad shettistaev, vetimmacher, veyavi bidme chetzyah temurat ola uvidme chetzyah temurat shelamim.
Amar rabbi yose: im lechach nitkavvevn mittechilla, hoil vei efshar lehotzi shene shemot keachat — devarav kayyaymin. rabbi yose hayeynu rabbanan! kullah rabbi yose katane la.
Tanya iddach: "behema, chetzyah ola vechetzyah chattat" — kullah tikrav ola, divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yose omer: tamut, veshavin beomer "chetzyah chattat vechetzyah ola" shettamut.
Shavin — manni? rabbi meir. peshita!
Mahu detema: i lav deashmeinan, hava amena tama derabbi meir lav mishshum "tefos lashon rishon", ella hayeynu tama — chattat meorevet kereva.
Vaafillu ki amar "chetzyah chattat", vahadar amar "chetzyah ola", kereva — ka mashma lan dela.
Tanya iddach: amar "behema zo chetzyah ola vechetzyah shelamim" — kedosha, veenah kereva, osa temura, utemuratah kayyotze bah.
Manni? rabbi yose hi, peshita dikdosha veenah kereva!
Temuratah itzterich leh, demahu detema: nehi dehi la karva — temuratah tikrav, ka mashma lan. may shena hi dela karva — dehavya la kedushsha dechuya, temuratah name mikkoach kedushsha dechuya kaatya.
Amar rabbi yochanan: behema shel shene shuttafim, hikdish chetzyah shello, vechazar velakach chetzyah acheret vehikdishah — kedosha veenah kereva, veose temura, utemuratah
b: Kayyotze bah. shema minna telat: shema minna kedushshat damim (nidcha) [medacha].
Ushema minna, baale (mumin) [chayyim] nidchin, ushema minna dichuy meikkaro have dichuy.
Amar abbaye: hakkol modim hecha deamar "chetzyah ola vechetzyah maaser" — divre hakkol ola kereva.
Hecha deamar "chetzyah temura vechetzyah maaser", may?
Temura kereva, shekken noheget bechol hakkodashim, o dilma maaser kereva, shekken makdish lefanav uleacharav? teku.
Mishna "hare zo tachat zo", "temurat zo", "chalifat zo" — hare zo temura. "zo mechullelet al zo" — en zo temura.
Veim haya hekdesh baal mum — yotze lechullin, vetzarich laasot damim.
Gemara lememra detachat lishshana deatpose hu, ureminhu: kodshe bedek habbayit, amar "chalifat zo" "temurat zo" — lo amar kelum.
"Tachat zo", "mechullelet al zo" — devarav kayyaymin.
Vei salka datach lishshana deittefose hi, may shena resha umay shena sefa?
Amar abbaye: "tachat" mashkachat la lishshana deittefose velishshana deachole. lishshana deatpose, dichtiv:

a: "Veim tachteha taamod habbaheret".
Deachole, dichtiv: "tachat hannechoshet avi zahav", vehilkach, gabbe kodshe mizbeach deavdin temura — lishshana deatpose hu, gabbe kodshe bedek habbayit dela avdin temura — lishshana deachole hu.
Amar rava: afillu bekodshe mizbeach mashkachat la lishshana deachole hu, kegon shehaya hekdesh baal mum.
Amar rabbi ashe: afillu bevaal mum name mashkachat la lishshana deachole, umashkachat lishshana deatpose. yado akkodesh — chol have, yado achol — kodesh have.
Bae abbaye: hayu lefanav shete behemot shel kodesh baalot mum, ushete behemot shel chullin temimot, veamar "hare ellu tachat ellu", mahu?
Mi amar leatpose velake, o dilma: kol hecha deikka hettera — la shavek inish hettera veaved issura?

Veim timtze lomar, kol hecha deikka hettera la shavek inish veaved issura, hayu lefanav shete behemot shel kodesh, veachat mehen baalat mum, ushete behemot shel chullin, veachat mehen baalat mum, veamar "hare ellu tachat ellu", mahu?
Mi amar: temima tachat temima — leatpose, baalat mum tachat baalat mum — leachole.
O dilma, temima dechullin tachat baalat mum dehekdesh, baalat mum dechullin tachat temima dehekdesh, vetarvayyhu lake?

Veim timtze lomar, kol hecha deikka hettera — la aved issura, uleachole hu, vela lake. hayu lefanav shalosh behemot shel kodesh, veachat mehen baalat mum, veshalosh behemot shel chullin temimot, veamar: "hare ellu tachat ellu".
Mi amrinan, midditmimot tachat temimot leatpose, temimot name tachat baalat mum leatpose? o dilma, hacha name, kol hecha deikka hettera la aved issura, vehahi batrayyta leachole have.

Veim timtze lomar, hacha name, kevan deakkatti gavra la ittachzak beissure, la shavek hettera veaved issura. bae rav ashe: hayu lefanav arba behemot shel kodesh veachat mehen baalat mum, vearba behemot shel chullin, veamar "hare ellu tachat ellu", mahu?
Hacha vadday, kevan deittachzak gavra beissure (bechullan), lake bearba malkiyyot.
O dilma, af al gav deittachzak beissura, la shavek inish hettera veaved issura, vehave batrayyta leachole have? teku.
Im haya hekdesh baal mum yotze lechullin kulei.
Amar rabbi yochanan: yotze lechullin devar tora, vetzarich laasot damim middivrehem, veresh lakish amar: af tzarich laasot damim devar tora.
Bemay askinan? i nema aonaa, beha nema resh lakish af tzarich laasot damim devar tora?
Veha tenan: ellu devarim sheen lahem onaa: haavadim, vehashshetarot, vehakkarkaot, vehahekdeshot!
Ella, abbittul mikkach beha nema rabbi yochanan tzarich laasot damim middivrehem?
b: Vehaamar rabbi yirmeya akkarkaot dechullin, verabbi yona amar ahekdeshot, tarvavyyhu mishshemeh derabbi yochanan amri: onaa en lahen, bittul mikkach yesh lahem!
Leolam abbittul mikkach, veefoch.
Umi matzet amrat efoch? hanicha leman deamar ahekdeshot, vechol shekken akkarkaot.
Ella leman deamar akkarkaot, aval hekdeshot en lahen bittul mikkach, hechi efoch leha?
Amar rabbi yirmeya: la tefoch.
Lema bedishmuel ka mippalgi, deamar shemuel: hekdesh shave mane shechillelo al shave peruta mechullal. derabbi yona let leh dishmuel, verabbi yirmeya it leh dishmuel.
La, ben demar uven demar — it leh dishmuel, derabbi yona savar: ki amar shemuel — diavad, aval lechattechilla la amar, verabbi yirmeya savar: afillu lechattechilla.
Veibbaet ema, leolam la tefoch, udeka kashya lach matnitin "ellu devarim... hekdeshot" — kidrav chisda.
Deamar rav chisda: en lahen onaa — enan betorat onaa, daafillu pachot mikkede onaa chozer.
Amar ulla: la amru ella beshamuy bitre, aval beshamuy bitlata, veaf al gav deate bemea — la hadar.
Ini? vehaamar rav safra: hecha amrinan mea kitre utere kima? leinyan edut, aval leinyan umedana — batar deot azlinan.
Vetu telata utelata, la azlinan batar batra? deyad hekdesh al haelyona!
Kasavar ulla: tzarich laasot damim middivrehem, vechol derabbanan akkilu be rabbanan.
Mishna "hare zo tachat ola", "tachat chattat" — lo amar kelum. "tachat chattat zo", vetachat ola zo", "tachat chattat vetachat ola sheyyesh li babbayit" — haya lo, devarav kayyaymim.
Amar al habbehema temea veal baalat mum "hare ellu ola" — lo amar kelum. "hare ellu leola" — yimmachru, veyavi bidmehem ola.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav: matnitin dela kerabbi meir, dei kerabbi meir — ha en adam motzi devarav levattala.
"Hare ellu leola" — yimmachru veyavi bidmehen ola. tama divhema temea uvaalat mum, dela chazyayn — la baayayn muma, aval mafrish nekeva leasham o leola — baayayn muma.
Amar rav yehuda, amar rav: matnitin dela kerabbi shimon, ditnan, rabbi shimon omer: timmacher shello bemum.
Hadaran alach ketzad maarimin.

a: Mishna kol haasurin legabbe mizbeach osrin bechol shehen — harovea vehannirba, vehammuketze vehanneevad, vehaetnan vehammechir, vehakkilayim vehatterefa, veyotze dofen.
Ezehu muketze? hammuketze laavoda zara, hu asur uma shealav muttar. veezehu hanneevad? kol sheovdin oto, hu uma shealav asur. veze vaze muttar baachila.
Gemara amar mar: osrin bechol shehen, dela batli berubba. tenena: kol hakkodashim shennitarvu bechattaot metot o beshor hanniskal, afillu echad beribbo — yamutu.
Vekashya lan, may kaamar?
Hachi katane: nitarvu bahen mechattaot metot, o shor hanniskal — afillu beribbo yamutu.
Itzterich, salka datach amena: hatam hu deissure hanaa, aval hacha delav issure hanaa — ema: livtel berubba, ka mashma lan.
Verova venirba name tenena: nitarvu rovea venirba — yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyimmachru, veyavi bidme yafe shebbahen meoto hammin!
Amar rav kahana: amrita lishmata kammeh derav shimi bar ashe, amar li: chada bechullin, vachada bekadashim.
Utzerichi, dei ashmoinan gabbe kadashim — mishshum dimisi, aval gabbe chullin — ema livtelu.
Uvechullin name tenena: veellu asurin veosrin bechol shehen — yen nesech, vaavoda zara, vetzippore metzora, veorot levuvin.
Vesear nazir, ufeter chamor, uvasar bechalav, veshor hanniskal, veegla arufa, vechullin shennishchatu baazara, vesair hammishtalleach — hare ellu asurin veosrin bechol shehen!
Tzerichi, dei ashmeinan hatam — deissure hanaa dela batli, aval hacha — livteli.
Vei ashmoinan hacha, dilgavoah dimis, aval lehedyot — ema: issure hanaa livtelu berubba, ka mashma lan.
Verovea venirba, menalan daasiri legavoah? detanu rabbanan: "min habbehema" — lehotzi rovea venirba.
Vahalo din hu, uma baal mum shello neevda bo avera pasul legabbe mizbeach, rovea venirba shenneevda bahen avera — eno din sheasurin legabbe mizbeach?!
Choresh beshor vachamor yochiach, shenneevda bo avera, umuttar legabbe mizbeach.
Ma lechoresh beshor vachamor, sheen chayyayvin mita, tomar berovea venirba, shechayyayvin mita.
Tol lach ma sheheveta, hare shenneevda bahen avera bishne edim.
Neevda bahen avera al pi ed echad, o al pi habbealim, minnayin?

Amar rabbi shimon: ani dan, uma baal mum sheen hateraat shene edim posalto meachila — hodaat ed echad posalto mehakerava, berovea venirba shehodaat shene edim posalto meachila — eno din shehodaat ed echad posalto mehakerava!
Talmud lomar "min habbehema" lehotzi rovea venirba, veha atya middina (la atya)!
b: Amar rav ashe: mishshum deikka lememar meikkara dedina pircha — ma levaal mum shekken mumo nikkar.
Tomar berovea venirba, sheen mumo nikkar, hoil veen mumo nikkar yehe kasher legabbe mizbeach — talmud lomar "min habbehema", lehotzi rovea venirba.
Min habbakar — lehotzi et hanneevad, vahalo din hu: uma etnan umechir shetztzippuyayn muttarin — hen asurin, neevad shetztzippuyo asur — eno din shehu asur?
O chilluf, uma etnan umechir shehen asurin — tzippuyehen muttarin, neevad shemmuttar — yehe tzippuyo muttar?
Im ken bittalta "lo tachmod kesef vezahav alehem velakachta lach"!

Ani akayyeymennu: "lo tachamod kesef vezahav" — bedavar sheen bo ruach chayyim, aval bedavar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim, hoil (vehen) [vehu] muttar — yachol yehe tzippuy muttar? talmud lomar "min habbakar" — lehotzi et hanneevad.
Matkef la rav chananya: tama demaateh kera, ha la maateh kera — tzippuy muttar? vehachtiv "veibbadtem et shemam" — kol heasuy lishmam!
Hahu lechannot lahem shem hu daata: levet galya" korin oto "bet karya", "pene melech" — "pene chelev", "en kol" — "en kotz".
Veefoch ana: "min habbehema" — lehotzi et hanneevad, "min habbakar" — lehotzi rovea venirba!
Hatam meinyayna dikra, ketiv gabbe behema "veish ki yitten shechovto bivhema mot yumat", gabbe bakar ketiv "vayyamiru et kevodam betavnit shor ochel esev".
"Min hatztzon" — lehotzi et hammuketze, "umin hatztzon" — lehotzi et hannogeach. amar rabbi shimon: im neemar rovea — lamma neemar nogeach? veim neemar nogeach — lamma neemar rovea?
Lefi sheyyeshno barovea, ma sheen ken bannogeach. yesh barovea, sheharovea ose ones keratzon, ma sheen ken bannogeach.
Yesh bannogeach, shehannogeach meshallem et hakkofer, ma sheen ken barovea. hutzerach lomar rovea, vehutzerach lomar nogeach.
Vehay tanna mayyte la mehacha, detanya: harovea vehannirba (vechullam) [vechulei]. hem kekadashim shekkadam mum over lehekdeshan.
Utzerichin mum kavua lifdot alehen, shenneemar: "ki moshchatam bahem mum bam".

May talmuda? chassore michassera, vehachi katane: minnayin shehen asurin? talmud lomar "ki moshchatam bahem mum bam", vetana deve rabbi yishmael: kol makom shenneemar 'hashechata — eno ella devar erva vaavoda zara.
Devar erva — dichtiv "ki hishchit kol basarvgo", avoda zara — dichtiv "pen tashchitun vaasitem lachem pesel temunat kol samel", kol shehammum posel bahen — devar erva vaavoda zara poslin bahen.
Vetana deve rabbi yishmael, "min habbehema min habbakar umin hatztzon" may daresh behu? mibbee leh perat lechole, zaken, umezoham.

Vetanna kamma, deappekinhu lehane kerae lerovea venirba, chole, zaken, umezoham mena leh? nafka leh "min hatztzon, min hakkevasim umin haizzim". uletanna deve rabbi yishmael, orcheh dikra leishtaoye hachi.
Ezehu muketze laavoda zara vechulei. amar resh lakish: en asur ella muketze lesheva shenayim.
Shenneemar: "vayhi ballayla hahu vayyomer [lo Adonai] kach et par hashshor asher leavicha ufar hashsheni sheva shanim".

Vehatam muketze bilchud hava? neevad name hava! amar rav acha bar yaakov: muketze laavod, velo avaduhu. rava amar: leolam avaduhu, vechiddush hu, kidrabbi abba bar kahana, deamar rabbi abba bar kahana: shemona devarim hittiru beoto layla — chutz, velayla, vezarut,

a: Ucheli sharet, ucheli ashera, vaatze ashera, umuketze, veneevad.
Amar rav tovi bar matna, amar rabbi yoshiyya: minnayin lemuketze min hattora? shenneemar "tishmeru lehakeriv li bemoado" — kol sheosin lo shimmur.

Matkef la abbaye: ella meatta, (ayyteyt) [ayyti] immera detzoma, vela aved leh shimmur, hachi name dela chaze lehakerava? amar leh: ana "tishmeru lehakeriv li bemoado" kaamena — "li" velo leadon acher, veezehu acher shemmakrivin lo? heve omer: zo avoda zara.
Amar rava bar rav adda, amar rav yitzchak: en muketze asur ella ad sheyyaavdu [bo]. ulla amar rabbi yochanan: ad sheyyimseruhu lechumere avoda zara.
Baha amar rabbi yochanan: ad sheyyaachiluhu karshine avoda zara. amar leh rabbi abba levaha: mippalgitu attun aulla? amar leh: la, ulla name ki kaamar — hu deshafe leh karshine avoda zara.
Amar rabbi abba: yada beha leshannoye shemata, vei la desalek hatam — la hava yada, deeretz yisrael gerama leh. amar leh rav yitzchak: baha mikkan umikkan hava.
Detane rav chananya teritaa kammeh derabbi yochanan: en muketze asur ella ad sheyyaasu bo maase, hu tane la (vahadar) [vehu] amar la: may "maase"? — ad sheyyiggazez veyaavdu bo.
Ezehu neevad kulei. mena hane mille?
Amar rav pappa: deamar kera "mimmashke yisrael", min hammuttar leyisrael, vei salka datach asiri lehedyot, lema li kera (maataynahev) [lemaotinhu] miggavoah?
Vechol hecha daasiri lehedyot — la bae kera? veha terefa, daasira lehedyot, umaateh kara miggavoah!
Detanya: keshehu omer "min habbakar" lematta, sheen talmud lomar, ella lehotzi et hatterefa.
Itzterich, salka datach amina: hane mille — denitrefa veachar kach nitkaddesha, aval nitkaddesha veachar kach nitrefa — ema (dateysheray) [detishtere] legavoah.
Veha mehacha nafka, "kol asher yaavor tachat hashshavet", perat litrefa sheenah overet.

Hahu name itzterich, salka datach amena: hane mille hecha delo hayta lah sheat hakkosher, denolda terefa mimmee immah, aval hecha dehayta lah sheat hakkosher, veyatzat laavir haolam, veachar kach nitrefa — ema tishtere legavoah, ka mashma lan.

Mishna veezehu etnan? — haomer lezona "hevlich tale ze bischarech", afillu hen mea, kullan asurin. vechen haomer lachavero "hevlaych tale ze vetalin shifchatcha etzel avdi" — rabbi meir omer: eno etnan, vachachamim omrim: etnan.
Gemara amar mar: vaafillu hen mea, kullan asurin. hechi dame? illema deshakla agra mea behemot — peshita dechullehu asiri, ma li chad, ma li mea!
La tzericha, deshakla agra chada, veyahev la mea, dechullehu mikkoach etnan kaatu.
Tanu rabbanan: natan lah velo ba aleha, ba aleha velo natan lah — etnanna muttar. natan lah velo ba aleha, "etnanna" karet leh? vetu, ba aleha velo natan lah, may yahev la?
Ella hachi katane: natan lah, veachar kach ba aleha; ba aleha, veachar kach natan lah — etnanna muttar. velechul aleh etnan lemafrea? amar rabbi elazar:
b: Shekkadma vehikrivattu. hechi dame? i nema deakneye nihalay lealtar — peshita demuttar, dead kan lo ba aleha!
Veella, daamar la: "la nikkene lich ad sheat bia", mi matzya makreva leh? "ish ki yakdish et beto kodesh laAdonai" amar rachamana, ma beto birshuto, af kol birshuto!
La tzericha, daamar la: "la (mikkanya) [nikkene] lach ad sheat bia, vei mitzterich lach nikkene lach meachshav".
Bae rav oshaya: kadma vehikdishattu, may? tifshot leh midderabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: kadma vehikrivattu. hikrivattu hi deha leteh bishat bia, aval hikdishattu — asur!
Hi gufa kamibbaya leh: hikrivattu, (veha) [deha] leteh bishat bia — muttar, aval hikdishattu bishat bia — asur.
O dilma, kevan ditnan "amirato laggavoah kimsirato lehedyot", hikdishattu muttar, vechol shekken hikrivattu? teku.
Ba aleha veachar kach natan lah etnanna — muttar, vehatanya: ba aleha venatan lah, vaafillu ad shenem asar chodesh — etnanna asur!
Amar rav chanan bar rav chisda: la kashya, ha deamar la "hibbaali li betale ze", ha deamar la "hibbaali li betale" setam.
"Tale ze", veha mechussar meshicha! bezona goya, dela kanya bimshicha. veibbaet ema: afillu bezona yisreelit, kegon dekae bachatzera.
Ha yahaveh la meikkara, deshavvevye la appoteke, vaamar la: "im ad yom peloni yahevna lach zuze — mutav, veim lav — tale beetnannich".
Amar rav: echad etnan zachar, veechad etnan kol arayot asur, chutz meetnan ishto nidda.
May tama? "zona" ketiv, veha lav zona hi.
Velevi amar: afillu ishto nidda. may tama? "toeva" ketiv, veha toeva hi.
Velevi name, vehachtiv "zona"! amar lach: hahi "zona", velo zone. verav, hahi zona velo zone mena leh?

Nafka leh midderabbi, detanya: rabbi omer: en etnan asur ella (kol) etnan [kol arayot] habbaot lo baavera, aval etnan ishto nidda, veshennatan lah sachar lehafekaatah, veshennatna lo [hi] beetnanno — muttarin.
Af al pi sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar: "uvetittech etnan veetnan lo nittan [lach] (lah) vattehi lehefech".
Verav, hay "toeva" may aved leh? mibbee leh kidabbaye, deamar abbaye: zona goya — etnanna asur.
May tama? ketiv hacha "toeva", uchetiv hatam "ki kol asher yaase mikkol hattoevot hael", ma lehallan arayot sheen kiddushin tofsin bah, hachi name en kiddushin tofsin bah.
Vechohen shebba aleha — en loke aleha mishshum zona, may tama? deamar kera: "lo yechallel zaro" — mi shezzaro meyuchas acharav, yatza goya deen zaro meyuchas acharav.
Zona yisreelit — etnanna muttar, ma taam? deha kiddushin tofsin bah, vechohen shebba aleha — loke mishshum zona, may tama? deha zaro meyuchas acharav.

Verava amar: echad ze veechad ze, etnanna asur, vechohen habba aleha loke mishshum zona. may tama? yalfi mehadade — ma zona yisreelit belav, af zona goya belav, uma etnan zona goya asur, af etnan zona yisreelit asur.
Metivi: echad zona goya veechad zona yisreelit — etnanna asur. teyuveta deabbaye! amar lach abbaye: ha manni? rabbi akiva hi, deamar: en kiddushin tofsin bechayyayve lavin.
Veha kamashma lan, dechol zona la tafsi ba kiddushin, dumeya dealmana dela tafsi ba kiddushin.
Ulerava, may shena dekatane "kegon almana lechohen gadol"? dumeya dealmana — ma almana la lake ad dematri be, af zona — ad deamar "he licha".
Leappoke midderabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: panuy habba al penuya shello leshem ishut — asaah zona, aval hecha dezona meikkara — hachi name deasur.
Lishshana achrina: ki katane ha — baarayot sheen kiddushin tofsin bah.
Veha katane sefa: almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot — etnanna asur, veha hane kiddushin tofsin bahen! ha manni?

a: Rabbi elazar hi, deamar: panuy habba al happenuya shello leshum ishut asaah zona. i rabbi elazar, may irya almana? nitne penuya!
Almana itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil uvinyan av hu — la nittasru, ka mashma lan.
Haomer lachavero "he lach tale ze" kulei. veha shifcha leeved mishra sharya! amar rav huna: etzlo kaamar, veha dekatane "eved" — lishshana mealleya kaamar.
I hachi, may tama derabbi? amar shemuel bar rav yitzchak: leolam avdi, vechi katane beeved ivri.

I hachi, may tama derabbanan? shifcha leeved ivri mishra sharya! hacha vemay askinan — kegon delet leh ishsha uvanim, detanya: en lo ishsha uvanim — en rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit, yesh lo ishsha uvanim — rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit.
Mishna veezehu "mechir kelev"? haomer lachavero "hevlaych tale ze tachat kelev".
Vechen shene shuttafin shechalku, echad natal asara veechad tisha vachelev, shekkeneged hakkelev asur, vesheim hakkelev muttar.
Etnan hakkelev umechir zona — hare ellu muttarin, shenneemar "shenayim" velo arbaa. valdotehen muttarin — "hen" velo valdotehen.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "mechir kelev" — zehu chalife chelev, vechen hu omer: "timkor ammecha velo hon velo ribbita bimchirehem".
Ema etnan (zona) [mammash], im ken (lo karev) havu telata, "gam shenehem" — velo shelosha!
Mi kaamrinan anan etnan umechir? etnan velo mechir kaamrinan.
Im ken, nema kera "lo tavi etnan zona vachelev", middichtiv "etnan zona umechir kelev" — shema minna.

Hashshuttafin shechalku, echad natal kulei. [ammay]? nippok chado lahade kalba, vehanach kullehu lishtero! hacha vemay askinan? kegon ditfe deme chelev mechad minnayyhu, (vehay) [vehahu] tufeyayna dechelev shede bechullehu.
Etnan kelev umechir zona muttar kulei. amar leh rava mipparzakya lerav ashe:
b: Mena ha milleta daamur rabbanan en zenut livhemot? amar leh: la (nishmot) [lishtemit] kera lichtov "etnan zona vachelev".
Tanya name hachi: minnayin leetnan kelev umechir zona shemmuttarin? shenneemar "shenayim" velo arbaa. valdotehen muttarin, shenneemar "gam shenehem" — "hem" velo valdotehen.
Amar rava: velad hannirbaat asura, hi uveladah nirbeu. nogachat asura, hi uveladah nagchu.
Velad muketze veneevad — muttar. may tama? leimmeh aktzeya, leimmeh palchi la. ikka deamri: velad muketze veneevad — asur. may tama? denicha leh benifcheh.
Amar rav achadvuy bar amme, amar rav: hamekaddesh beferesh shor hanniskal, mekuddeshet. beferesh egle avoda zara, enah mekuddeshet. may tama? i baet ema kera, vei baet ema sevara.
I baet ema sevara: nicha leh gabbe avoda zara benifcheh, gabbe shor hanniskal — la nicha leh benifcheh.
I baet ema kera, gabbe avoda zara ketiv: "vehayita cherem kamohu", kol sheatta mehayye mimmennu hare hu kamohu. gabbe shor hanniskal ketiv: "lo yeachel et besaro" — besaro asur, pirsho muttar.
Mishna natan lah maot — hare ellu muttarin. yenot ushemanim uselatot, vechol davar shekkayyotze bo karev al gabbe hammizbeach — asur. natan lah mukedashin — hare ellu muttarin.

Ofot — hare ellu asurin, shehaya baddin: ma im hammukedashin, shehammum posel bahen — en etnan umechir chal alehen; of, sheen hammum posel bo — eno din shello yehe etnan umechir chal alav? talmud lomar "lechol neder" — lehavi et haof.

Kol haasurin legabbe mizbeach — valdotehen muttarin. rabbi eliezer omer: velad terefa lo yikrav al gabbe hammizbeach. rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: keshera sheyyanka min hatterefa — pesula meal gabbe hammizbeach. kol hakkodashim shennaasu terefa — en podin otan, sheen podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: natan lah chittin vaasaatan solet, zetim vaasaatan shemen, anavim vaasaatan yayin. tane chada: asurim, vetanya iddach: muttarin. amar rav yosef: tane gureyon demin asporak — bet shammay osrin uvet hillel mattirin.
Bet hillel savri: "hem" — velo valdotehen, "hem" — velo shinnuyehen.
Bet shammay savri: "hem" — velo valdotehen, "gam" — lerabbot shinnuyehen, ulevet hillel, hachtiv "gam"! "gam" levet hillel kashya.
Tanu rabbanan: "bet Adonai elohecha" — perat lefara, sheen baa labbayit, divre rabbi elazar. vachachamim omrim: lerabbot et harikkuin.
Man chachamim? amar rav chisda: rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi, detanya: natan lah zahav, rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: en osin rikkuin, afillu achore bet hakkapporet.
Natan lah mukedashin — hare ellu muttarin kulei.

Veyihyu mukedashin etnan umechir chal alehen, mikkal vachomer: uma ofot sheen hammum posel bahen — etnan umechir chal alehen, mukedashim shehammum posel bahen — eno din sheetnan umechir chal alehen? talmud lomar "lechol neder" — lehotzi et hannadur.
Tama demaatinhu kera, ha la maatinhu kera hava amina: ki yahev la mukedashin — chal alehen etnan umechir? veha lav mamona hu!
Amar rav hoshaya: bemamne al pischo, verabbi hi, detanya: "veim yimat habbayit mihyot misse".
Hachayehu misse, mikkede achila velo mikkede mikkach.
Rabbi omer: af mikkede mikkach, sheim en lo mamne acherim immo al pischo veal chagigato, umeotav chullin, sheal menat ken hikdishu yisrael pischehen.
Kol haasurim legabbe mizbeach vechulei. amar rav: kol haasurim legabbe mizbeach valdotehen muttarim, vetane ala: verabbi eliezer oser.

Amar rav huna bar chinnana, amar rav nachman: machloket sheibberu ulevassof nirbeu, derabbi eliezer savar "ubbar yerech immo hu", verabbanan savri "lav yerech immo hu", aval nirbeu ulevassof ibberu — divre hakkol muttarin.
Rava amar: machloket shennirbeu ulevassof ibberu, derabbi eliezer savar: ze vaze gorem asur, verabbanan savri: ze vaze gorem muttar.
Aval ibberu ulevassof nirbeu — divre hakkol asurin. verava letameh, deamar rava: velad nirbaat asur, hi uveladah nirbeu, velad nogachat asur, hi uveladah nagchu.

Lishshana acharina amri la. amar rav huna bar chinnana, amar rav nachman: machloket shennirbeu keshehen mukedashin, derabbi eliezer savar bizzuy milleta, verabbanan savri la. aval nirbeu keshehen chullin, hoil vehishtannu — divre hakkol muttarin.

Rava amar rav nachman: machloket keshennirbeu keshehen chullin, derabbi eliezer savar: bizzuy milleta, verabbanan savri: hoil vehishtannu — muttarin, aval nirbeu keshehen mukedashin — divre hakkol asurin.

a: Velad terefa kulei. leman deamar terefa (enah) yalda — mashkachat la kegon shennitrefa ulevassof ibbera.
Uveha peligi, derabbi eliezer savar: ze vaze gorem asur, verabbanan savri: ze vaze gorem muttar.
Leman deamar terefa enah chayya, mashkachat la kegon sheibbera ulevassof nitrefa, uveha peligi: derabbi eliezer savar ubbar yerech immo hu, verabbanan savri ubbar lav yerech immo hu.

Amar rav huna: modim chachamim lerabbi eliezer beefroach betzat terefa sheasur. may tama? ad kan la peligi aleh derabbi eliezer ella bivlad behema, demeavvera ka ravya, aval betzat terefa demiggufa detarnegolta ka ravya — afillu rabbanan modu.

Amar leh rava lerav huna: tanya dimsayyay lach, melo tarvad rimma habbaa meadam chay — rabbi eliezer metamme, vachachamim metaharin. ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh ella berimma, defirsha bealma hu, aval betza demiggufa detarnegolet hu — afillu rabbanan modu.
Amar leh abbaye: adderabba, ippecha mistabbera — ad kan la pelig rabbi eliezer alayyhu derabbanan ella berimma, deikkeri adam mechayyim "rimma", dichtiv: "vetikvat enosh rimma uven adam tolea".

Aval gabbe betza, emat gadla? lechi masrecha, vechi asracha — afra bealma hu, afillu rabbi eliezer mode! veod, tanya behedya: mode rabbi eliezer lachachamim beefroach betzat terefa shemmuttar! amar leh: i tanya — tanya.
Rabbi chanina ben antignos omer: keshera kulei. may tama? illema demippatma minna, ella meatta heechilah karshine avoda zara, hachi name daasira?
Ella, tane rabbi chanina teritaa kammeh derabbi yochanan: kegon shehenikah chalav roteach mishshacharit leshacharit, hoil vichola laamod aleha meet leet.

Kol hakkodashim shennaasu terefa en podin kulei. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "tizbach" — velo gizza, "veachalta" — velo lichlavecha, "basar" — velo chalav. mikkan sheen podim et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim.
Ikka deamri: "tizbach veachalta" — en lecha bahen hetter ella mishsheat zevicha veelach, kasavar: podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim.
Hadaran alach kol haasurin.
Mishna yesh bekodshe mizbeach sheen bekodshe bedek habbayit, veyesh bekodshe bedek habbayit sheen bekodshe mizbeach.
Shekkodshe mizbeach osin temura, vekodshe bedek habbayit en osin temura. kodshe mizbeach chayyayvin (alav) [alehen] mishshum piggul, notar, vetame,
b: Veladan vachalavan asur leachar pidyonan, vehashshochatan bachutz chayyayv. en notnin mehen laummanin bischaran — ma sheen ken bekodshe bedek habbayit.
Yesh bekodshe bedek habbayit, shessetam hekdeshot levedek habbayit, hekdesh bedek habbayit chal al hakkol, umoalin begiddulehen, veen bahen hanaa labbealim.
Gemara uchelala hu dechol kodshe mizbeach osin temura? vahare ofot dekodshe mizbeach hen, utenan: hammenachot vehaofot en osin temura! ki katane — abbehema.
Vahare valad kodshe mizbeach hu, utenan: en havvalad ose temura. ha manni? rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: valad ose temura.
Vahare temura atzmah, dekodshe mizbeach, utenan: en temura osa temura! ki katane — aikkar zivcha.
Hasheta daatet lehachi, afillu tema rabbanan, ki katane — aikkar zivcha.
Veen notnin mehen laummanin kulei. ha kodshe bedek habbayit notnin? amar rabbi avahu: deamar kera "veasu li" — mishshelli.
Yesh bekodshe bedek habbayit kulei. amar mar: setam hekdeshot levedek habbayit, vechal al hakkol. man tanna? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: dela kerabbi yehoshua.

Detanya: hammakdish nechasav, vehaya bahen behema reuya legabbe mizbeach, zecharim unekevot — rabbi eliezer omer: zecharim yimmachru letzorche olot, unekevot yimmachru letzorche shelamim, udemehen yippelu im shear nechasim levedek habbayit.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: zecharim hen atzman yikrevu olot, unekevot yimmachru letzorche shelamim veyavi bidmehen olot, ushear nechasim levedek habbayit.
Ufeliga derav adda bar ahava, deamar rav adda bar ahava amar rav: beeder shekkullo zecharim, afillu rabbi eliezer mode, dela shavek inish kodshe mizbeach umakdish levedek habbayit.
Lo nechleku ella beeder sheyyesh bo mechetza zecharim umechetza nekevot, verabbi eliezer savar: en cholek et nidro, umiddinkevot lav olot — zecharim name lav olot.
Verabbi yehoshua savar: cholek et nidro.
Lishshana achrina amri la, amar rav adda bar ahava amar rav: beshello hikdish ella behema, afillu rabbi eliezer mode, dela shavek inish kodshe mizbeach umakdesh levedek habbayit.

Lo nechleku ella kesheyyesh shear nechasim immahen, verabbi eliezer savar: en adam cholek et nidro, middishar nechasim la lekodshe mizbach, behema name la lekodshe mizbeach, verabbi yehoshua savar: adam cholek et nidro.
Udemehen yippelu im shear nechasim levedek habbayit — bishlama lelishshana batra, hayeynu dekatane: "im shear nechasim levedek habbayit".
Ella lelishshana kamma, litne "yippelu levedek habbayit"! tanya name hachi: "udemehen yippelu levedek habbayit".
Hekdesh bedek habbayit chal al hakkol. leetoye may? amar ravina: leetoye shippuye veniva.
Umoalin begiddulehen. leetoye may? amar rav pappa: leetoye bikdushshat mizbeach, chalev hammukedashin uvetze torin.

Kidtanya: chalev hammukedashin uvetze torin — lo nehenin velo moalin. bamme devarim amurim? bekodshe mizbeach, aval bekodshe bedek habbayit — hikdish tarnegolet moalin bevetzatah, chamorah moalin bachalavah.
Vaafillu leman deamar moalin begiddule mizbeach, hane mille giddulin dachazu lammizbeach, aval giddulin dela chazu lammizbeach — en moalin bahen.

a: Mishna echad kodshe mizbeach veechad kodshe bedek habbayit en meshannin otan mikkedushsha likdushsha, umakdishin otan hekdesh illuy, umachrimin otan, veim metu — yikkaveru. rabbi shimon omer: kodshe bedek habbayit im metu — yippadu.

Gemara amar rav huna: kodshe mizbeach shehitpisan lecherme chohanim — lo asa kelum. may tama? amar kera: "kol cherem kodesh kadashim hu laAdonai" — kol cherem dekodesh kadashim have, hahu laAdonai leheve.
Metivi: kodshe bedek habbayit shehitpisan, ben lekodshe mizbeach ben lecherme chohanim — lo asa kelum.
Cherme chohanim shehitpisan, ben lekodshe mizbeach, ben lekodshe bedek habbayit — lo asa kelum.
Ha kodshe mizbeach shehitpis lecherme chohanim — ma sheasa asuy, teyuveta derav huna!
Amar lecha rav huna: ki shayyeyra — ahada shayyeyra, dekadshe mizbeach shehitpisan levedek habbayit — ma sheasa asuy, aval lecherme chohanim — lo asa kelum.
Velitneyay gabbe hanach! tanna deit beh tarte — katane, delet beh tarte — la katane.
Tenan: "makdish otan hekdesh illuy", may lav "hekdesh illuy" — levedek habbayit, umachrimin" — lecherme chohen?
La, idi veidi kodshe bedek habbayit, vela shena mappek lehu bilshon "hakkodesh" levedek habbayit, vela shena mappek lehu bilshon "(cherme) [cherem]" levedek habbayit.

Veha la tane hachi, detanya bevarayyta: hekdesh illuy — kodshe bedek habbayit, machrimin otam — cherme chohanim! veod, ha tanya: kodshe mizbeach shehikdishan lecherme chohanim — ma sheasa asuy! teyuveta derav huna, teyuveta.
Veha rav huna kera kaamar! amar ulla: amar kera "cherem kol cherem".
Umi amar ulla hachi? veha amar ulla: hammatpis ola levedek habbayit — en bah ella ikkuv
b: Gizbarin bilvad!
Leolam rabbanan, vekara limila [hu] daata.
Limila lema leh kera? kodshe kadashim ketiv beh!

Velitamaych, ha deamar rabbi yannay: en meila meforeshet min hattora ella beola bilvad, shenneemar: "nefesh ki timol maal vechata bishgaga mikkodshe Adonai", hameyuchadin laAdonai. aval chattat veasham la nafka ella midderabbi.
Detanya, rabbi omer: "kol chelev laAdonai" — lerabbot emure kadashim kallim limila.

Lema li kera? "kodshe kadashim" ketiv behu! ella, af al gav dekodshe kadashim" ketiv behu, bae kera lerabboyinhu limila. charamim name, af al gav dekodshe kadashim" ketiv behu, bae kera lerabboyinhu limila.
Gufa: hammakdish ola levedek habbayit — en bah ella ikkuv gizbarin bilvad. metivi: hammakdish ola levedek habbayit — asur leshochotah ad shettippade!
Midderabbanan, hachi name mistabbera, middekatane sefa: im avar ushechatah — ma sheasa asuy.
Ella may midderabbanan? i hachi, ema sefa: umoalin shete meilot, vei midderabbanan — ammay shete meilot? hachi kaamar: ureuya limol bah shete meilot.
Veim metu yikkaveru kulei.
Amar rabbi yochanan lerabbanan: echad kodshe mizbeach veechad kodshe bedek habbayit — hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha.
Veresh lakish amar: lerabbanan, kodshe bedek habbayit hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, kodshe mizbeach lo hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha.

Veze vaze, mode lerabbi shimon, dekodshe bedek habbayit lo hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, vekodshe mizbeach hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, vedivre hakkol, baal mum meikkaro lo haya bichlal haamada vehaaracha.

Tenan: rabbi shimon omer: "kodshe bedek habbayit shemmetu yippadu". bishlama lerabbi yochanan, deamar lerabbanan echad ze veechad ze hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, hayeynu deitzterich rabbi shimon lefaroshe "kodshe bedek habbayit shemmetu yippadu".
Ella leresh lakish, lema leh lefaroshe? lema "im metu yippadu"!
Amar lach resh lakish: rabbi shimon la hava yada may deamar tanna kamma, vehachi kaamar leh: i bekodshe mizbeach — modena lach, bekodshe bedek habbayit — im metu yippadu.
Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan: "im behema asher yakrivu mimmenna" — bevaale mumin sheyyippadu hakkatuv medabber.
Atta omer bevaale mumin, o eno ella bivhema temea? keshehu omer "im bivhema temea ufada veerkecha" — hare behema temea amur,

a: Ha ma ani mekayyem "veim kol behema asher lo yakrivu mimmenna korban laAdonai" — bevaale mumin sheyyippadu.
Yachol yippadu al mum over? talmud lomar "asher lo yakrivu mimmenna" — sheenah kereva kol ikkar, yatzta zo sheenah kereva hayyom ella lemachar.
Veamar rachamana: aved la haamada vehaaracha.

Amar rav giddel, amar rav: may tama deresh lakish, deamar lerabbanan kodshe bedek habbayit hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, kodshe mizbeach lo hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha? deamar kera: "veheerich hakkohen otah ben tov uven ra".
Ezehu davar sheeno chaluk ben tov lera? heve omer: ze kodshe bedek habbayit, veamar kera "otah" lemaote kodshe mizbeach.
Verabbi yochanan, "otah" lemaote may? lemaote baal mum meikkaro.

Uletanna deve levi, deamar daafillu baal mum meikkaro bichlal haamada vehaaracha, detane levi: hakkol hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, vaafillu baal mum meikkaro, vechen tane levi bematniteh: vaafillu chayya, vaafillu ofot, vehachtiv "otah"! kashya.

Amar rav yehuda, amar rav: may tama derabbi shimon deamar, kodshe mizbeach hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, kodshe bedek habbayit lo hayu? deamar kera: "veheerich hakkohen otah ben tov uven ra", ezehu davar shechaluk ben tov uven ra? heve omer: ze kodshe mizbeach, veamar kera "otah" lemaote bedek habbayit.
I hachi, "ben tov lera" mibbee leh! kashya.
Metivi: metu temimin — yikkavru, uvaale mumin — yippadu. bamme devarim amurim? bekodshe mizbeach, aval bekodshe bedek habbayit — ben temimin ben baale mumim yikkaveru.
Rabbi shimon omer: echad kodshe mizbeach veechad kodshe bedek habbayit, temimim — yikkavru, baale mumin — yippadu. teyuveta derabbi yochanan meresha!
Amar lach rabbi yochanan: hacha vemay askinan? bevaal mum meikkaro.
Hachi name mistabbera, dei tema shekkadam hekdeshan et muman — liflog rabbi shimon ala, ella lav shema minna bevaal mum meikkaro.
Ella, lema tehve teyuveteh deresh lakish!
Resh lakish mokem la beshekkadam hekdeshan et muman, i hachi, niflog rabbi shimon ala.
Resh lakish mefach afech, vehachi motev mimmechilta achariti: metu, ben temimin ben baale mumin — yikkaveru. [bamme devarim amurim? bekodshe mizbeach, aval bekodshe bedek habbayit — yippadu.]
Rabbi shimon omer: temimim — yikkavru, uvaale mumin — yippadu. teyuveta derabbi yochanan missefa!
Amar lach rabbi yochanan: hacha vemay askinan? bevaal mum meikkaro. hachi name mistabbera, dei tema beshekkadam hekdeshan et muman — niflog rabbi shimon ala.
Ella lema tehve teyuveteh deresh lakish! amar lach resh lakish: hacha vemay askinan — beshekkadam hekdeshan et muman. veniflog rabbi shimon ala! amar lach resh lakish: hachi name diflig rabbi shimon.
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: leresh lakish, deamar lerabbanan: kodshe mizbeach lo hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, vekatane "kodshe mizbeach
b: Baale mumin yippadu", umokminan lah beshekkadam hekdeshan et muman, shema minna podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim!
Hacha bemay askinan? besheavar ushechatan.
Kidtanya: kol hakkodashim shennafal bahen mum, ushechatan, rabbi meir omer: yikkaveru, vachachamim omrim: yippadu.
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: lerabbi shimon, deamar: kodshe bedek habbayit lo hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, ammay temimim yikkaveru? mishshum dachazu lehakerava.
Kidtanya: hammatpis temimim levedek habbayit, keshehen nifdin — enan nifdin ella lammizbeach, shekkol harauy lammizbeach eno yotze mide mizbeach leolam.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye, veamri la rava: lerabbi yochanan, demokem la bevaal mum meikkaro, vechulle alma sevira lehu devaal mum meikkaro dela have bichlal haamada vehaaracha. vela?!
Vehatnan: kol hakkodashim shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshan venifdu, chayyayvin babbechora uvammattanot, veyotzin lechullin liggazez veleaved.
Veladan vachalavan muttar leachar pidyonan, vehashshochatan bachutz patur, veen osin temura, veim metu yippadu.

Veamar rav yehuda, amar rav: zo divre rabbi shimon, deamar kodshe mizbeach hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, kodshe bedek habbayit lo hayu, keditnan: rabbi shimon omer kodshe bedek habbayit im metu yippadu.
Umode rabbi shimon bevaal mum meikkaro shennifde, may tama? daamar kera: "otah", "otah" lemaote baal mum meikkaro. aval chachamim omrim: afillu baal mum meikkaro haya bichlal haamada vehaaracha!
Amar leh: man chachamim? tanna deve levi. i hachi, "zo divre rabbi shimon" vetu la? "zo divre rabbi shimon umachluketo" mibbee leh!
Amar leh: hay dela katane hachi, mishshum derav savar la keresh lakish, deamar lerabbanan: kodshe bedek habbayit hayu bichlal haamada vehaaracha, kodshe mizbeach lo hayu.
Veresha katane: "veim metu yippadu", vesefa katane: "im metu yikkaveru".
Veibbaet ema, rav kerabbi yochanan sevira leh, udeka kashya lach "zo divre rabbi shimon umachluketo" mibbee leh, ema hachi name.
Mishna veellu hen hannikbarin: kadashim shehippilu — yikkaveru, hippila shilya — tikkaver, veshor hanniskal, veegla arufa, vetzippore metzora, vesear nazir,
Ufeter chamor, uvasar bechalav, vechullin shennishchatu baazara. rabbi shimon omer: chullin shennishchatu baazara yissarefu, vechen chayya shennishchata baazara.

Veellu hen hannisrafin: chametz bappesach — yissaref, uteruma temea, vehaorla, vechile hakkerem, et sheddarkan lissarevf — yissaref, veet sheddarkan lehikkaver — yikkaver, umadlikin befat uveshemen shel teruma. kol hakkodashim shennishchatu chutz lizmannan vechutz limkoman — hare ellu yissarefu.

a: Asham taluy — yissaref, rabbi yehuda omer: yikkaver. chattat haof habbaa al hassafek — tissaref, rabbi yehuda omer: yetilenna laamma.
Kol hannikbarin — lo yissarefu, vechol hannisrafin — lo yikkaveru. rabbi yehuda omer: im ratza lehachemir al atzmo lisrof et hannikbarin — rashshay. amru lo: eno muttar leshannot.

Gemara sear hannazir yikkaver. rame leh tavi lerav nachman: tenan sear hannazir yikkaver, ureminhu: haoreg "melo hassit" mitztzemer bechor beveged — yiddalek habbeged, missear hannazir ufeter chamor besak — yiddalek hassak!
Amar leh: kan benazir tame, kan benazir tahor.
Amar leh shannet nazir annazir, peter chamor appeter chamor kashya! ishtik vela amar leh vela midde. amar leh: midde shemia lach beha? amar leh: hachi amar rav sheshet — kan besak, kan besear.
Ittemar name: amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: kan — besak, kan — besear. rabbi elazar amar: kan — benazir tahor, kan — benazir tame.
Amar leh: livtel sak berubba! amar rav pappa: betzippureta. tzippureta? lishallofinhu!
Amar rabbi yirmeya: ha manni? rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: im ratza lehachemir al atzmo lisrof et hannikbarim — rashshay. amar leh: ka kashya lan leshallofinhu, veat mokmat la kerabbi yehuda!
Hachi kaamena: im efshar leshallofinhu — mutav, veim lav — okma kerabbi yehuda, deamar: im ratza lehachemir al atzmo lisrof et hannikbarin — rashshay.
Veellu hen hannisrafin. amar mar: chametz bappesach — yissaref. setam lan tanna kerabbi yehuda, deamar: en biur chametz ella serefa.
Teruma temea vehaorla kulei. ha chetzad? ovchalin bisrefa, mashkin bikvura.
Chattat haof kulei. tanya, amar rabbi yehuda: chattat haof habbaa al hassafek — yetilenna laamma, umenattecha ever ever, vezorkan laamma, umitgalgelet veholechet lenachal kidron.
Kol hannikbarin lo yissarefu kulei. may tama? mishshum denikbarin efran asur, venisrafin efran muttar.
Venikbarin efran asur? vehatanya: dam hannidda uvesar hammet shennifrechu — tehorin, may lav tehorin umuttarin? la, tehorin vaasurin.
Metiv rav pinchas: olat haof shennitmatztza damah, mureatah venotza shellah yatzu mide meila. may lav yatzu mide meila umuttarin? la, yatzu mide meila vaasurin.
Venisrafin dehekdesh efran muttar? veha tanya: kol hannisrafin efram muttar, chutz meefer ashera — veefer dehekdesh leolam asur!
Umirav hu dela kaarev lehu vetane lehu, mishshum daashera yesh lah betila begoy, hekdesh en lo betila olamit. katane miha: efer hekdesh leolam asur.
Amar rame bar chama: kegon denafla deleka baatze hekdesh meeleha, kevan dela yedia man, dela have inish delimol, delippok efran lechullin.
Rav shemaya amar: ki tanya ha matnita bitrumat haddeshen tanya, dilolam asur.
Detanya: "vesamo" benachat, "vesamo" kullo, "vesamo" shello yefazzer.
Hadaran alach yesh bekodshe mizbeach, uselika la massechet temura.

Mishna sheloshim vashesh karetot betora: habba al haem, veal eshet av, veal hakkalla, habba al hazzachur, veal habbehema, veishsha hammevia habbehema aleha, habba al ishsha uvittah, veeshet ish, habba al achoto, veal achot aviv, veal achot immo, veal achot ishto, veal eshet achiv, veal eshet achi aviv, veal eshet achi immo, veal hannidda.

Vehamegaddef, veoved avoda zara, vehannoten mizzaro lammolech, uvaal ov, umechallel shabbat, vetame sheachal kodesh, vehabba el hammikdash tame, vehaochel chelev, vadam, venotar, ufiggul, vehashshochet, umaale bachutz,

Vehaochel chametz bappesach, vehaochel vehaose melacha beyom hakkippurim, vehamefattem et hashshemen, vehamefattem et hakketoret, vehassach et hashshemen hammishcha. vehappesach vehammila mitzvat ase.
Al ellu chayyayvin al zedono karet, veal shiggato chattat, veal lo hoda shellahem asham taluy, chutz min hametamme mikdash vekadashav, mippene shehu beole veyored, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: af hamegaddef, shenneemar: "tora achat yihye lachem laose bishgaga", yatza megaddef sheeno ose maase.
b: Gemara minyayna lema li? amar rabbi yochanan: sheim asaan kullan behelem achat – chayyayv al kol achat veachat.
Vetu, ha ditnan: avot melachot arbaim chaser achat, minyayna lema li? sheim asaan kullan behelem achat – chayyayv al kol achat veachat.
Tu, ha ditnan: arbaa mechussere kappara, minyayna lema li?
Leappoke midderabbi eliezer ben yaakov, deamar: chamishsha have, detanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: ger mechussar kappara ad sheyyizzarek dam alav, ahachi tena arbaa.
Tu, ha ditnan: arbaa meviin al hazzadon kishgaga, minyayna lema li?
Leappoke midderabbi shimon, detanya, rabbi shimon omer: shevuat happikkadon – lo nittan zedonah lechappara, ahachi tena arbaa.
Tu, ha ditnan: chamishsha meviin korban echad al averot harebe, minyayna lema li?

Mishshum deka bae lemitna sefa: nazir im nitma tumeot harebe, umashkachat la kegon deittammi bishvii vechazar venitma bashshevii, umanni? rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi, deamar: nezirut detahara, min shevii hu dechayel aleh.
Dei temar rabbi hi, kevan dinzirut detohora ad shemini la chayyla aleh, hechi mashkachat la?
