I denitma bishvii vechazar venitma bishvii – kulla chada tumea arichta hi.
Vei denitma bashshemini vechazar venitma bashshemini, kevan deyatza beshaa haruya lehavi bah korban, chayyayv al kol achat veachat! ella shema minna rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi.
May rabbi umay rabbi yose berabbi yehuda? detanya: "vekiddash et rosho bayyom hahu" – beyom havaat korbenotav, divre rabbi. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: beyom tiglachto.
Tu, ha ditnan: chamishsha meviin korban ole veyored, minyayna lema li?
Mishshum dekatane sefa: nasi kayyotze bahen. chamishsha leappoke midderabbi eliezer, deamar: nasi mevi sair.
Tu, ha ditnan: arbaa avot nezikin, minyana lema li?

Leappoke midderabbi oshaya, deamar: shelosha asar avot nezikin hen. ulerabbi oshaya, minyayna lema li? leappoke midderabbi chiyyay, deamar: esrim vearbaa avot nezikin. ulerabbi chiyyay minyana lema li? leappoke masor umefaggel.
Amar mar: sheim asaan kullan behelem achat – chayyayv al kol achat veachat.

Bishlama patur ligmare la matzet amrat, dichtiv: "ki kol asher yaase mikkol hattoevot haelle venichretu". ella ema: avar chada – nitchayyev chada, avar kullehu behelem achat – eno chayyayv ella achat!
Amar rabbi yochanan: lechach yatza karet baachoto – lechallek.
Matkef la rav bivi bar abbaye, ema: achoto difrat kera – nichayyayv chada ala, vechullan kevan divhelem achat – la nichayyayv ella achat!
Ulerav bivi bar abbaye, mi let leh hada detanya: kol davar shehaya bakkelal veyatza min hakkelal lelammed, lo lelammed al atzmo yatza ella lelammed al hakkelal kullo yatza.
Ketzad? "vehannefesh asher tochal basar vegomer", vahalo shelamim bichlal hakkodashim hayu. lamma yatzu?
Lehakkish alehen: ma shelamim shehen kodshe mizbeach vechayyayvin alehen – af kol shehen kodshe mizbeach chayyayvin alehen, yatzu kodshe bedek habbayit!
Amar leh rav bivi: bar minna. lav mi amrat hatam yatzu kodshe bedek habbayit?
Hacha name: ma achoto meyuchedet shehi erva veen lah hetter bechayye osrah, af kol sheen lah hetter bechayye osrah, yatza eshet ish, sheyyesh lah hetter bechayye vaalah!

Amar rabbi yona veittema rav huna bereh derav yehoshua, amar kera: "ki kol asher yaase mikkol hattoevot vegomer", hoil vechach hikkish hu, hukeshu kol haarayot kullan laachoto: ma achoto chayyayvin aleha bifne atzmah, af kol chayyayvin aleha bifne atzmah.
Ulerabbi yitzchak deamar: chayyayve charetot bichlal hayu, velamma yatza karet baachoto – ledunah becharet velo bemalkot,
Lechallek mena leh? nafka leh mivveel ishsha beniddat tumeatah lo tikrav" – lechallek al kol ishsha veishsha.
Verabbanan name, tippok lehu mivveel ishsha beniddat tumeatah"! in hachi name. ella karet daachoto lemay ata? mibbee leh lechallek al achoto veal achot aviv veal achot immo.
Hane lema lehu lechallek? hare shemot muchelakin vahare gufim muchelakim! ella ema: lechallek al achoto shehi achot aviv veshehi achot immo.
Verabbi yitzchak, ha milleta mena leh? nafka leh min sefa dikra, dichtiv: "ervat achoto gilla".
Verabbanan, "achoto" desefa dikra may avdi leh? mibbee leh

a: Laachoto shehi bat aviv uvat immo, lomar sheen onshin min haddin.
Verabbi yitzchak, savar: onshin min haddin. veibbaet ema: yalef onesh meazhara.

Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi hoshaya: kol makom sheatta motze shene lavin vecharet echad – challek chattat benehen. umay hi? mefattem vesach, dichtiv: "al besar adam lo yisach uvematkunto vegomer", karet echad, dichtiv: "asher yirkach kamohu vaasher yitten mimmennu al zar venichrat meammav".
Vechi meachar delavin muchelakim, karet daachoto dichtav rachamana lema li?
Lerabbi yitzchak – kidit leh, lerabbanan mibbaya lehu: lomar, sheen onshin min haddin! lerabbi yitzchak, mappek leh lechayyev al achoto shehi achot aviv veshehi achot immo.

Verabbanan? denafka lehon min "achoto" deresha. verabbi yitzchak? savar "achoto" deresha orcheh dikra hi, umappek lechallek meachoto" desefeh dikra, lechallek al achoto shehi achot aviv veshehi achot immo.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, af anan name tenena: hamefattem et hashshemen, hamefattem et hakketoret, vehassach beshemen hammishcha.

Lema li detanya hamefattem et hakketoret bemitza? lav ha ka mashma lan: ma ketoret lav bifne atzmo vechayyayvim aleha karet bifne atzmo – af mefattem shemen vesach name, kevan delav bifne atzmo – chayyayvim alav bifne atzmah?

Vechi tema deka bae lemitna pittumin bahade hadade – nitnihu efoch: hamefattem et hakketoret, vehamefattem et hashshemen, vehassach shemen hammishcha, ammay pallegeh leshemen? lav ha kamashma lan, deyesh chilluk chattaot benehen? shema minna.
Habba al hazzachur. tanna bemay ka chashev?
I begavre – dal haishsha hannirbaat, uvatzra la chada! i binshe kachashev – dal minnehon habba al hazzachur veal habbehema, uvatzri lehu tarte!
Amar rabbi yochanan: leolam tanna gavre kachashev, vetane hachi: habba al hazzachur vehevi zachur alav, verabbi yishmael hi, deamar: chayyayv shetayim.
Veha middekatane megaddef besefeh, umokminan la kerabbi akiva, resha name rabbi akiva!

Vechi tema: rabbi akiva hi, uveresha savar la kerabbi yishmael, vehaamar rabbi avahu: habba al hazzachur vehevi zachur alav, lerabbi yishmael demappek leh mittarte kerae, mivveet zachar lo tishkav", umivvelo yihye kadesh mibbene yisrael" – chayyayv shetayim,
Lerabbi akiva eno chayyayv ella achat, demechad kera nafek leh: "et zachar lo tishkav", keri beh: lo tishshachev!
Ella: resha rabbi yishmael, uvimgaddef savar la kerabbi akiva. i hachi, nitne name: habba al habbehema, vehevi behema alav!
Ha amar abbaye: habba al habbehema vehevi behema alav, af lerabbi yishmael eno chayyayv ella achat, dechi ketiv kera – begavre ketiv.
Rabbi elazar mishshemeh derav amar: tanna teni sheloshim veshalosh chattaot, uteni shalosh karetot, lesayyominhu becharetot.
Dekatane sefa: pesach umila bemitzvat ase – pesach umila ammay katane lehu?
Veittema leetoye korban alehon, mi mayyte? vehatanya: hukkesha kol hattora kullah laavoda zara, dichtiv: "tora achat yihye lachem laose bishgaga. vehannefesh asher taase beyad rama" –
Ma avoda zara shev veal taase, af kol shev veal taase!
Ella lav shema minna: tena sheloshim veshalosh chattaot man deavdi beshogeg, vahadar tena shalosh karetot lesayyominhu lecharetot, shema minna.
Hamechallel et hashshabbat. amri: shabbat arbaim chaser achat havvyayn! amar rabbi yochanan: tanna shiggat shabbat uzedon melachot, dela michayyayv ella chada.
Detanya: "henna" shehi "achat" – shiggat shabbat uzedon melachot.
Venitne zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot, demichayyayv arbaim chaser achat!
Detanya: "veasa meachat mehenna" – peamim shechayyayv achat al kullan, ufeamim shechayyayv al kol achat veachat. detanya: "achat" shehi "henna" – zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot!
Tena shiggat shabbat uzedon melachot adifa leh, demechattat miha la mippetar.
Vechen atta motze gabbe avoda zara, dekatane: shiggat avoda zara uzedon avodot.
Shiggat avoda zara hechi dame? illema deamad bevet avoda zara vesavar bet hakkeneset hi vehishtachava – hare libbo lashshamayim!
Veella dachaza inderata useged le? i dekabbeleh aleh beeloah – bar sekila hu! vei dela kabbeleh beeloah – lav midde hu!
Ella, meahava umiyyira.
Hanicha leabbayye deamar chayyayv, ella lerava deamar patur, may ikka lememar?
b: Ella beomer muttar, dead kan la kavae minneh rava merav nachman ella i chada michayyayv i tarte michayyayv, avel mippetar ligmare la bea minneh.
Rav pappa amar: mashkachat la betinok shennishba leven haggoyim, deyada daasira avoda zara, vehane avoda zara la yada daasiran.

Vei baet ema: afillu tema begadol – kegon deka tae behaden kera: "lo taasun itti elohe chesef velohe zahav vegomer" savar: ki asira hishtachavaa laavoda zara dechesef vezahav, aval demine acharine sharya, dehayynu shiggat avoda zara uzedon avodot.

Rav acha bereh derav ika mishshemeh derav bivi amar: tanna shem shabbat veshem avoda zara katane. mimmay? middekatane: habba al ishsha uvittah veal eshet ish, veha yesh bitto meanusato, dela katane la!
Amri: dichtivan katane, dela ketivan la katane.
Vehaikka bat ishto uvat bittah uvat benah, dichtiva, vela katane! ella: shem ishsha uvittah katane? hachi name: shem shabbat veshem avoda zara katane.

Rav acha bereh derav ika rame dileh addileh: mi amar rav bivi bar abbaye hachi, shem shabbat katane veshem avoda zara katane? vehaittemar: hammaale evre penim bachutz – chayyayv, evre chutz bachutz – chayyayv.
Vekashya leh lerav bivi bar abbaye: "i hachi, ha ditnan: sheloshim vashesh karetot betora – telatin usheva ninhu, deikka hammaale vehammaale!" may kashya leh? nishne: shem haalaa katane!
Mi dame? shabbat vaavoda zara tena yathon abbinchehon, gabbay karetot, deirya, meshanne: "shem shabbat katane shem avoda zara katane", gabbe haalaa, mi tena yathon binchehon deshanni hachi?
Bea minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera: shete karetot velav echad, mahu? amar leh: shochet veheela kaamrat? hane shene lavin ninhu,
I leman degamar miggezera shava – neemar kan havaa veneemar lehallan havaa,
Ma lehallan lo anash ella im ken hizhir – af kan lo anash, ella im ken hizhir.
Leman demayyte la behekkesh – amar kera: "sham taale... vesham taase", makkish shechita lehaalaa, ma haalaa lo anash ella im ken hizhir, af shechita lo anash ella im ken hizhir.
Dilma shete mitot velav echad kaamrat? ma hi – ov veyiddeoni.
Amar leh deha pelugeta derabbi yochanan veresh lakish. detanu gabbe sanhedrin: baal ov veyiddeoni, vekashya lan, umay shena gabbe sekilot tane yiddeoni, vegabbe karetot la tane yiddeoni?
Amar rabbi yochanan: hoil ushenehem belav echad neemru. venema yiddeoni, vela nema baal ov! kasavar: hoil ufatach hakkatuv bevaal ov.
Veresh lakish amar: hoil veen bo maase. veresh lakish may tama la amar kerabbi yochanan?
Amar rav pappa: deha chalukin hen bemitot. verabbi yochanan amar lecha: chalukka delav – have chalukka, chalukka demita – la havya chalukka.
Verabbi yochanan may tama la amar keresh lakish? kasavar: man tanna karetot – rabbi akiva hi, deamar la bainan maase.
Veresh lakish? nehi derabbi akiva la bae maase rabba, maase zuta bae.
Baal ov, may maase it beh? hakashat zerootav have maase. megaddef, may maase it beh? akimat sefatav have maase.

Ka salka datin: hakashat zerootav have maase zuta afillu lerabbanan. metivi: baavoda zara eno chayyayv ella al davar sheyyesh bo maase, kegon shezzibbach, vekitter, venissech, vehishtachava. vekashya lan, hishtachavaa let ba maase!

Veamar resh lakish: ha manni? rabbi akiva hi, deamar la bainan maase. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema rabbanan, kefifat komato have maase. mikkelal disvira leh leresh lakish allibba derabbanan kefifat komato lerabbanan la have maase. hakashat zerootav have maase?!
Veella ki kaamar resh lakish hakashat zerootav have maase zuta, allibba derabbi akiva, aval lerabbanan la have maase.
I hachi, ammay tane: yatza megaddef sheen bo maase? nitne: yatza megaddef uvaal ov! chada mittarte katane.
Velitne baal ov vela litne megaddef! megaddef itzterich leh, salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv karet dileh bimkom korban, ema mode leh lerabbi akiva, ka mashma lan dela.
Ulla amar: baal ov dekatane bimkatter lashshed. matkef la rava: im ken, hayeynu oved avoda zara! ella amar rava: mekatter lashshed al menat lechabbero.
Amar leh abbaye: im ken, hayinu chover chaver! amar leh: hattora amra chover chaver kegon ze, biskila. veella chover chever divlav – heden hu?

Amar leh: kidtanya: "vechover chaver" – echad chover gadol veechad chover katan, vaafillu chover linchashim veakrabbim – chayyayv. amar abbaye: hay man devae lemitzmad zibbura veakrabba – asur, vei kaatu batreh – shere.
Lerabbi yochanan, deamar kefifat komato have maase, akimat

a: Sefatav neheve maase gabbe megaddef? amar rava: shane megaddef, hoil veyeshno ballev, aval bealma akimat sefatav have maase.
Metiv rabbi zera: yatzu edim zommin sheen bo maase, veammay? ha "al pi" ketiv bahen! amar rava: shane edim zommin, hoil veyeshnan biriyyay.
Haochel chelev. tanu rabbanan: "kol chelev shor vechesev vaez lo tochelu" – lechayyev al kol achat veachat, divre rabbi yishmael. vachachamim omrim: eno chayyayv ella achat.
Nema beha kamippalgi, derabbi yishmael savar: lokin al lav shebbichlalot, verabbanan savri: en lokin al lav shebbichlalot?
Leolam savar rabbi yishmael: en lokin al lav shebbichlalot, veshane hacha, dimyaytri leh kerae – nichtov kera "kol chelev lo tochelu", "shor vechesev vaez" lema li? shema minna lechallek.
Verabbanan? i la ketiv: "shor vechesev vaez" hava amena: afillu chelev chayya bammashma, lehachi ketav: "shor kesev vaez", lememra: dechelev shor vechesev vaez hu deasur, aval dechayya shere.
Shappir kaamri leh! ella hayeynu tama, derabbi yishmael dekasavar: im ken, lichtov "kol chelev shor lo tochlu", "kesev vaez" lema li? shema minna lechallek.
Verabbanan savri: i ketav rachamana "kol chelev shor", hava amena: nelaf "shor" "shor" missinay,
Ma gabbe sinay – chayya vaof kayyotze bahen, af gabbe achila – chayya vaof kayyotze bahen, lehachi ketav rachamana "shor vechesev vaez", lememra dehane deasur, aval chayya vaof shere.
Shappir ka amri leh! ella hayeynu tama, dekasavar: nichtov "kol chelev kesev lo tochelu", i name: "kol chelev ez lo tochelu", "shor vechesev vaez" lema li? shema minna lechallek.
Verabbanan savri: i ketav "kol chelev kesev", hava amena: chelev kesev asur, veshor vaez shere. vechi tema, may ulemeh dechesev – mishshum denitrabba bealya,
Vechidtana rabbi chananya: lamma mana hakkatuv emurin beshor veemurim bechesev, veemurim, beez, dichtiv: "ach bechor shor vegomer?
Tzerichi, dei ketav shor, hava amena: kesev vaez la yalfinan minneh, deikka lemifrach: ma leshor, shekken nitrabba binsachim.
Nichtov rachamana bechesev venelaf shor vaez mikkesev – ikka lemifrach: ma lechesev, shekken nitrabba bealya.
Nichtov rachamana ez venelaf shor vechesev minneh – ikka lemifrach: ma leez, shekken nitrabba etzel avoda zara.
Min chad la yalfinan, nichtov tarte venelaf chada mittarte! he den? nelaf shor mikkesev vaez – it lehon pircha: ma lechesev vaez, shekken nitrabbu etzel happesach!
La nichtov kesev venelaf mishshor vaez – it lehon pircha: ma leshor vaez, shekken nitrabba etzel avoda zara!
La nichtov ez, venelaf mishshor vechesev – it lehon pircha: ma leshor vechesev, shekken yesh bo tzad ribbuy! hilkach la yalfi mehadade.
Shappir ka amri leh! ella leolam tama derabbi yishmael kidamrinan meikkara, deim ken nichtov "kol chelev" velishtok. may amrat, hay dichtav "shor vechesev vaez" lemishre chelev chayya?
Ha ki ketav kera – beinyayna dekadashim, vedavar lamed meinyayno.

Mikkelal derabbanan savri: la yalfinan davar lamed meinyayno? la, dechulle alma yalfinan davar hallamed meinyayno, vehacha beha peligi, rabbi yishmael savar: lemedin lav millav ben millav uven millav decharet,

Dechol chelev shor vechesev vaez", millav dechukkat olam ledorotechem bechol moshvotechem kol chelev vechol dam lo tochelu", dichtiv beinyayna dekadashim, uvekadashim la it behon chayya, af "kol chelev shor", ki ketiv leh setama lekka lesappoke bechayya, hilkach "shor vechesev vaez" lechallek hu daata, lechayyev al kol achat veachat.
Veyalfinan lav dechol chelev" velav dechukkat olam" mikkaret dechi kol ochel chelev min habbehema asher yakrivu mimmenna", ma hahu lechallek – af haddin lechallek.
Verabbanan, lav millav yalfinan, lav mikkaret la yalfinan.

Veibbaet ema: hayeynu tamayyhu derabbanan, kedaamar leh rav mari lerav zevid: "ella meatta, alya dechullin tittesar amar leh" – "alecha amar kera: "kol chelev shor vechesev vaez", davar hashshave bishloshtan bainan, velekka".
Hilkach: ki ata "shor vechesev vaez" – lemishre alya dechullin hu daata. verabbi yishmael, amar lach: im ken, lema kera "kol chelev shor vechesev", ez lema li? shema minna lechallek.
Amar rabbi chanina: mode rabbi yishmael leinyan korban sheen mevi ella chattat achat, may tama? dela dame haden lav lelav daarayot.
Tanu rabbanan: "veasa achat" "veasa henna" – lechayyev al kol achat veachat,
Sheim achal chelev vechelev, shem echad bishne helemot – chayyayv shetayim, shete shemot behelem achat – chayyayv shetayim.

Amar leh rame bar chama lerav chisda: bishlama shem echad bishne helemot chayyayv shetayim, mishshum dehelemot mechallekin. ella shene shemot behelem achat, ammay chayyayv shetayim? ha bainan helemot mevchallekin, velekka!
Amar leh: hacha bemay askinan – kegon daachal chelev denotar, demichayyayv mishshum notar umishshum chelev. amar leh: im ken, nichayyayv name mishshum kodesh!

Ella amar rav sheshet: kegon daachal chelev dehekdesh, verabbi yehuda hi. detanya: achal chelev nevela, achal chelev mukedashin – chayyayv shetayim. rabbi yehuda omer: chelev mukedashin – loke shalosh.
Mechayyeychu ala bemareva: venokma kegon chelev deshor vechesev vaez, verabbi yishmael hi, deamar: loke shelosh!
b: Alma la okma kerabbi yishmael, deamar rabbi chanina: mode haya rabbi yishmael leinyan korban sheeno chayyayv ella chattat achat, hasheta name kerabbi yehuda la mittokma, deha amar rabbi eliezer: mode haya rabbi yehuda leinyan korban sheen mevi ella chattat achat!
Ella amar resh lakish mishshum bar touteni: hacha bemay askinan – kegon sheachalan bishne tamchuyin, veallibba derabbi yehoshua, deamar: tamchuyin mechallekim.
Gufa: achal chelev nevela – loke shetayim, chelev mukedashin – loke shetayim, rabbi yehuda omer: chelev mukedashin – loke shalosh.

Amar leh rav shezvi lerava: bishlama lerabbi yehuda, hayeynu dichtivi kerae: "chukkat olam". "kol chelev shor vechesev vaez lo tochelu", "vechol zar lo yochal kodesh" – ha telata lavin. ella lerabbanan, may tamayyhu?
Kasavri: lav dechukkat olam" bekadashim, velav dechelev shor" bechullin. utzerichi,
Dei ketav rachamana bekadashim, hava amena: kadashim hu dachamiri, deasur chelbo, aval chullin – ema la, mishshum hachi ketav rachamana: "kol chelev shor".

Vei ketav: "kol chelev shor", hava amena: chelev dechullin hu deasur mishshum delo huttar mikkelalo, aval chelev mukedashin dehuttar mikkelalo, hava amena: middehuttar besaran ishteri name chelban, tzerichi.
Verabbi yehuda savar: ki ketiv "chelev shor", bainyayna dekadashim ketiv.
Ella mikkelal derabbanan savri: la yalfinan davar hallamed meinyayno?
La, dechulle alma davar hallamed meinyayno, uveha kamippalgi, rabbi yehuda savar: lemedin lav millav velav mikkaret, verabbanan savri: lav millav yalfinan, lav mikkaret la yalfinan.

Ella lerabbi yehuda, "kol chelev vechol dam lo tochelu", lemay ata? mibbee leh lehakkish, detanya: "kol chelev vechol dam lo tochelu", ma chelev loke shetayim – af dam loke shetayim, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: en bo ella azhara echat.

Umay shena chelev deloke shetayim bela hekkesha, dichtav beh tere kerae "kol chelev vechol dam lo tochelu", "kol chelev shor vechesev"? dam name belav hekkesha nilke shetayim, dichtiv beh tere lavin "kol chelev vechol dam lo tochelu", "vechol dam lo tochlu bechol moshvotechem laof velabbehema"!
Ella ema: ma chelev loke shalosh, af dam loke shalosh.
Umay shena chelev deloke shalosh? dichtiv beh halen tere lavin velav dezarut – ha telata? dam name!
Itzterich, salka datach amena: hoil veitmeit dam mittumea – litmeit mizzarut, ka mashma lan hekkesha.
Veella lerabbanan, hekkesha lemay ata?
Mibbee leh lechidtanya: "kol chelev vechol dam lo tochelu", ma chelev meyuchad shechelbo chaluk mibbesaro, veen mitztarfin ze im ze – af dam, sheddamo chaluk mibbesaro.
Otzi dam sheratzim, hoil deen daman chaluk mibbesaran – mitztarfin.
Veha mehacha nafka? mehatam nafka: "veze lachem hattame" – limmed al dam hashsheretz vehashsheretz shemmitztarfin ze im ze!
I lav hekkesha, salka datach amena: hane mille letumea, aval laachila – ema la, ashmeinan hekkesha laachila.

Amar ravina: hilkach, dam nachash uvesaro mitztarfin. may ka mashma lan? hayeynu hekkesha! salka datach amena: sheretz, deitrabbi letumea – itrabbi laachila. nachash, dela itrabbi letumea – la itrabbi laachila, ka mashma lan hekkesha: kol mille deen damo chaluk mibbesaro mashma.
Amar rava: shalosh karetot haamurot baddam. lemay? achat ledam chullin, veachat ledam kadashim, veachat ledam hattamtzit.
Hanicha lerabbi yehuda, detanya: dam hattamtzit beazhara, rabbi yehuda omer: becharet.
Ella lerabbanan, hahi lemay ata? vaafillu lerabbi yehuda, karet nafka leh min "kol dam"!
Detanya: rabbi yehuda omer: "dam", ma talmud lomar "kol dam"?
En li ella dam kadashim shehannefesh yotze bo, dam chullin vedam hattamtzit, minnayin? talmud lomar: "kol dam"!
Ella ema: echad ledam chullin, veechad ledam kadashim, veechad ledam kissuy.
Veamar rava: chamishsha lavin haamurin bedam lamma? achat ledam chullin, veachat ledam kadashim, veachat ledam kissuy, veachat ledam evarin, veachat ledam hattamtzit.
Amar rabbi ila: achal maaser dagan vetirosh veyitzhar – loke shalosh. veha en lokin al lav shebbichlalot! shane hacha, dimyaytri kerae –

Mikkedi ketav rachamana: "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha", bifnim – in, bachutz – la, lema li dichtav rachamana: "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha vetiroshcha veyitzharecha"? lechallek.
I mehahu, hava amena: hane mille baase, aval belav ema la, ammetu lehachi

a: Ketav rachamana: "lo tuchal", leokoma belav.
Vaadayin, lav shebbichlalot hu! im ken, nema kera: "lo tuchal leochlam bisharecha", "masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha" lema li? leyachode achila dechol chad vechad.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: haochel lechem, kali, vecharmel – loke shalosh. veha en lokin al lav shebbichlalot! shane hacha dimyaytar kerae –
Lema kera lechem, venelaf kali vecharmel minneh. ikka lemifrach: ma lelechem, shekken nitrabba etzel challa!

Nichtov kali vela lichtov lechem, venelaf mikkali. lechem mikkali la ate, mishshum dekale iteh beeneh, lechem la iteh beeneh. karmel mikkali la ate, mishshum dekali nitrabba etzel menachot, karmel lo nitrabba etzel menachot!
Nichtov karmel venelaf lechem vekali minneh. ikka lemifrach: ma lecharmel shekken lo nishtanna mibberiyyayto! min chad la yalfi, nelaf chada min teren?

La nichtov kera lechem venelaf mikkali vecharmel – ikka lemifrach: ma lekali vecharmel deitanhon beenehon! la nichtov kera karmel venelaf millechem vekali – ikka lemifrach: ma lelechem vekali shekken nitrabbu etzel menachot!

Amar lach rabbi yitzchak: la nichtov kera kali, venelaf millechem vecharmel. may parchat? i parchat: ma lelechem, shekken nitrabba etzel challa – karmel yochiach! vei mishshum decharmel lo nishtanna mibberiyyayto – lechem yochiach! hilkach loke, dimyaytar.

Veema: kali dimyaytar michayyayv chada, akkullehon michayyayv chada! im ken, nichtov kera: "lechem karmel vekali", i name nichtov: "kali velechem vecharmel", ammay ketav lekali baemtza? hachi kaamar: lechem bekali nichayyayv vecharmel nichayyayv bekali.
Amar rabbi yannay: leolam al tehi gezera shava kalla beenecha, shehare piggul echad miggufe tora, velo limmedo hakkatuv ella miggezera shava.
Deamar rabbi yochanan, tane zavda bar levi: neemar lehallan: "veochlav avono yissa", veneemar kan: "vehannefesh haochelet mimmennu avonah tissa", ma lehallan karet – af kan karet.
Amar rabbi simay: leolam al tehi gezera shava kalla beenecha, shehare notar echad miggufe tora, velo limmedo hakkatuv ella miggezera shava.
May hi? yalef "kodesh" "kodesh" – "veochlav avono yissa ki et kodesh Adonai chillel", uchetiv: "vesarafta et hannotar baesh ki kodesh vegomer"
Amar abbaye: leolam al tehi gezera shava kalla beenecha, shehare bitto meanusato hen hen gufe tora, velo limmedah hakkatuv ella miggezera shava.
Deamar rava, amar li rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi: atya "henna" "henna" leissura,
Atya "zimma" "zimma" lisrefa.
Amar rav ashe: al tehi gezera shava kalla beenecha, shehare niskalim hen hen gufe tora, velo limmedah hakkatuv ella miggezera shava,
Detanya: neemar kan: "demehem bam" veneemar beov veyiddeoni: "demehem bam". ma lehallan – biskila, af kan – biskila.

Hammefattem et hashshemen kulei. tanu rabbanan: hammefattem et hashshemen lilmod bo, lemosro latztzibbur – patur, lasuch – chayyayv. vehassach mimmennu – patur, lefi sheen chayyayvin ella al sichat shemen hammishcha sheasa moshe bilvad.

Amar mar: lilmod bo al menat lemosro latztzibbur – patur. menalan? atya "matkunto" min "bematkunetah" diktoret, uchetiv legabbe ketoret: "lo taasu lachem" – lachem hu deasur, aval lemosro latztzibbur – patur, gabbe shemen name, lemosro latztzibbur – patur.

Vetihdar ketoret venelaf mishshemen: ma shemen ki mefattem lachatzayin – patur, af ketoret name ki mefattem lachatzayin – patur! allema amar rava: ketoret sheppittemah lachatzayin – chayyayv, shemen sheppittemo lachatzayin – patur?

Amar lach rava: gabbe shemen ketiv "uvematkunto lo taasu kamohu" – kamohu hu deasur, aval chetzyo shappir dame. gabbe ketoret dichtiv "vehakketoret asher taase" – kol asiyyay diktoret efshar demakter peras shacharit uferas ben haarbayim.
Tanu rabbanan: shemen hammishcha mor deror chamesh meot, kidda chamesh meot, kinneman besem chamesh meot, ukene vosem chamishshim umatayim, nimtzeu kullam elef veshiva meot vachamishshim.

Tanna minyayna ka mashma lan? tanna ha ka kashya leh, ema: kene vosem kekinnemon besem, ma kinnemon besem machatzito bachamishshim umatayim – af kene vosem machatzito chamishshim umatayim, dehavu lehu teren alafim.
Veema hachi name! im ken, nichtov kera: "kinnemon besem ukene vosem mechetza umechetza chamishshim umatayim".

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: keshehu shokel, behechrea hu shokel, o ayin beayin hu shokel? amar leh: rachamana ketav: "bad bevad", veat amrat behechrea? vehaamar rav yehuda: hakkadosh baruch hu yodea hacheraot, alma deit behu hechrea!

Ella, amar rav yehuda: dekinnemon besem ammay mayyte machatzito dachamesh meot, chamishshim umatayim bechad zimna vachamishshim umatayim bechad zimna? kevan dechullehon chamesh meot havayin, nayyte chamesh meot bevat achat! shema minna, middekamayyte la lekinnemon besem bitre zimne, hechrea it beh, vehakkadosh baruch hu yodea behechreot.
Umay "bad bevad"? amar ravina: shello yanniach mishkal bemishkal veyishkol.

Tanu rabbanan: shemen hammishcha sheasa moshe vemidbar – meshalleko haikkarin, divre rabbi yehuda. amar lo rabbi yose: vahalo lasuch haikkarin eno sippek! ketzad ose? heviu haikkarin ushelakum bemayim, vehetzif alehen shemen hammishcha, vekalat et hareach, vekippecho.
Amar lo rabbi yehuda:
b: Vechi nes echad naasa bashshemen hammishcha? vahalo nissim harebe naasu bo mittechillato vead sofo, techillato lo haya ella shenem asar log, uvo nimshach hammishkan vechelav veaharon uvanav kol shivat yeme hammilluim, uvo nimshechu kohanim gedolim umelachim, vechullo kayyaym leatid lavo,
Shenneemar: "shemen mishchat kodesh yihye ze li ledorotechem" – "ze" begimatriyya shenem asar luggin havyayn.

Tanu rabbanan "vayyikkach moshe et shemen hammishcha vayyimshach et hammishkan vegomer", rabbi yehuda omer: shemen hammishcha sheasa moshe bammidbar harebe nissim naasu bo mittechillato vead sofo: techillato lo haya ella shenem asar luggin, kamma yora bolaat, kamma ikkarin bolin, kamma haur soref, uvo nimshach mishkan vechelav, aharon uvanav kol shivat yeme hammeluim,

Uvo nimshechu kohanim gedolim umelachim. vaafillu kohen gadol ben kohen gadol taun meshicha. veen moshchin melech ben melech. veem tomar: mippene ma mashchu et shelomo? mippene machloket adoniyya, veet yehoash – mippene atalya, veet yehoachaz – mippene yehoyakim achiv, shehaya gadol meechav shete shanim.

Amar mar: vaafillu kohen gadol ben kohen gadol taun meshicha. menalan? dichtiv: "vehakkohen hammashiach tachtav mibbanav", nema kera "vehakkohen shettachtav mibbanav", may "hammashiach"? ha ka mashma lan daafillu mibbanav, hahu dimshach have kohen gadol, vei la meshach la have kohen gadol.
Amar mar: en moshchin melech ben melech. menalan? amar rav acha bar yaakov, dichtiv: "lemaan yaarich yamim al mamlachto hu uvanav kol hayyamim" – yerushsha hi.

Umippene ma mashchu et shelomo? mippene machloket adoniyya. menalan dechi ate machloket bae meshicha, vela kol devae malka moret leh malchuta? amar rav pappa, amar kera: "bekerev yisrael" – bizman sheshshalom beyisrael.

Tana: af yehu ben nimshi lo nimshach ella mippene machloket yoram ben achav: ammay? tippok leh demelech rishon hu! chassore michassera vehachi katane: malche bet david moshchin, malche yisrael en moshchin. veim tomar: mippene ma mashchu yehu ben nimshi? mippene machloket yoram ben achav.
Amar mar: malche bet david moshchin, veen malche yisrael moshchin. menalan? dichtiv: "kum meshachehu ki ze hu" – ze taun meshicha, veen acher taun meshicha.
Amar mar: mippene machloket yoram. umishshum machloket yoram ben achav nimal beshemen hammishcha? kidamar rav pappa: baafarsema dachya, hacha name baafarsema dachya.

Veet yehoachaz mippene yehoyakim, shehaya gadol mimmennu shete shanim. umi kashshish? vehachtiv: "uvene yoshiyya habbechor yochanan vehashsheni yehoyakim vehashshelishi tzidkiyyahu veharvii shallum", veamar rabbi yochanan: hu yehoachaz, hu tzidkiyyahu, hu shallum!

Ella leolam yehoyakim kashshish, veammay kare leh bechor – shehu bechor lammalchut. umi mokminan zuta kamme kashshisha? vehachtiv: "veet hammamlacha natan lihoram ki hu habbechor"! hahu memalle mekom avotav hava.

Amar mar: hu shallum hu tzidkiyya. veha bedare kachashev! umay kare leh shelishi? shehu shelishi labbanim, umay kare leh revii? shehu revii lammalchut, mishshum dimlach yechanya kammeh – bitchilla melach yehoachaz, vesof melach yehoyakim, vesof melach yechanya, vesof melach tzidkiyya.

Tanu rabbanan: hu shallum hu tzidkiyya, velamma nikra shemo shallum? shehaya shalem bemaasav. davar acher: shallum – sheshshalem malchut bet david beyamav, uma shemo? mattanya shemo, shenneemar: "vayyamlech et mattanya dodo tachtav vayyassev shemo tzidkiyya",
Deamar: lo yah yatzdik alecha et haddin im timrod bi, shenneemar: "vayviehu vavela" uchetiv: "vegam bammelech nevuchad netztzar melech bavel marad asher hishbio belohim".
Umi hava shemen hammishcha? vehatanya: mishshennignaz aron nignaz tzintzenet hamman, utzelochit shemen hammishcha, umaklo shel aharon shekedim uferachim,

Veargaz sheshshiggeru pelishtim doron lelohe yisrael, shenneemar: "veet kele hazzahav asher hashevotem lo asham tasimu vaargaz mitztziddo". umi genazo? yoshiyya melech yehuda genazo, shenneemar: "vayyomer hammelech el hakkohanim tenu et aron hakkodesh",
Veamar rabbi elazar: atya "sham" "sham",
Atya "dorot" "dorot",
Atya "mishmeret" "mishmeret". amar rav pappa: baafarsema dachya.

Tanu rabbanan: moshchin et hammelachim kemin nezer, veet hakkohanim kemin "ki". amar rav menashsheya: kemin "ki" yevani. tane chada: battechilla matztzik shemen al rosho veachar kach noten lo shemen ben rise enav, vetane achariti: battechilla noten lo shemen ben rise enav veachar kach matztzik lo shemen al rosho!

Tannae hi, ikka leman deamar meshicha adifa, veikka leman deamar yetzika adifa. may tama deman deamar yetzika adifa – shenneemar: "vayyitzok mishshemen hammishcha al rosh aharon", uman deamar meshicha adifa – kasavar: shekken nitrabba etzel kele sharet.
Vehachtiv: "vayyitzok" ulevassof "vayyimshach"! hachi kaamar: ma taam "vayyitzok" – mishshum "vayyimshach oto lekaddesho".

Tanu rabbanan: "kashshemen hattov hayyored al harosh vegomer" – kemin shete tippin margaliyyot hayu teluyot leaharon bizkano. amar rav kahana, tana: keshehu mesapper olot veyoshvot beikkare zekano. veal davar ze haya moshe rabbenu doeg, shemma chas veshalom maalti beshemen hammishcha.
Yatzta bat kol veamra: "ketal chermon sheyyored al harere tziyyon", ma tal en bo meila – af shemen sheyyored al zekan aharon en bo meila.
Vaadayin aharon haya doeg, shemma moshe lo maal, vaani maalti! yatzta bat kol veamra lo: "hinne ma tov uma naim shevet achim gam yachad", ma moshe lo maal, af atta lo maalta.
Tanu rabbanan: en moshchin et hammelachim ella al hammayayn, kede shettimmashech malchutan, shenneemar: "vayyomer hammelech el benayahu vegomer vehoradtem oto al gichon vegomer umashach oto sham".

Amar rav amme: hay man devae lidda i mashcha shatta i la, mayyte sheraga behalen asra yomin deven resh shatta leyoma dechippure, venitle beveta dela nashev zika, i meshich nehoreh nidda demassek shatteh.
Uman devae naaved iske, uvae denidda i matzlach iskeh i la, nirabbe tarnegola, i shamen veshafar nidda dematzlach.
Hay man devae nippok beorcha, uvae denidda i hadar leveteh – niol nekum beveta devahata, im chaze
